bloodline.defying-the-heavens.dragon.lor: Of the true dragons, rarest of the demon races. Born with a demon core, horned and whiskered, slow to grow and mighty when it has.

bloodline.defying-the-heavens.human.lore: Born of men, with your own face. The heavens' path is yours by birth; a beast's blood may yet be awakened in you.
bloodline.defying-the-heavens.lizard.lor: Of the great lizards that bask on sun-hot stones and hunt the marshes. Cold-blooded and patient, born with a demon core, quick as a whip.
bloodline.defying-the-heavens.tiger.lore: Kin of the White Tiger of the west. Striped and fierce, born with a demon core, its blows heavy and its eyes keen in the dark.

cultivation.defying-the-heavens.codex.en:
Cultivators address you according to your realm and theirs: those below you are polite or humble, and those above you talk down to you. If you stand four or more realms above a cultivator, they kneel before you.
Within your sect, members below you address you by your title.
Forms of Address

Alignment runs from Devilish through Neutral to Righteous. Neutral cultivators keep the peace unless provoked, while righteous and devilish ones attack each other on sight. Sects treat you according to your alignment.
Killing a cultivator who didn't provoke you makes your alignment more devilish; killing devilish cultivators makes it more righteous.
Alignment

Beyond the Overworld's sky lies space. The Overworld is one planet among thousands, circling hundreds of stars, and every other planet has land of its own to explore.
From Nascent Soul, fly high enough above the Overworld or the Jade Firmament and you rise out into space. Settlers live on its worlds, and they have wishes of their own.
The Astral Realm

A Formation Core raises a barrier around itself that only its sect (or its owner) can pass, and no monsters spawn inside it. A cultivator at least as strong as the formation can slowly break through. Break the core, or let it run out of qi, and the whole barrier falls.
Craft a Formation Core of your own to raise a barrier for yourself and the people you trust.
Protective Formations

Lands scarred by the ancient war between Heaven and the demons: craters, fissures and toppled spires, bones and broken walls, and water that runs red.
Their ghostly qi is denser than anywhere else, even the Netherworld, which makes them the best place for the ghost path. Elder beasts guard pools of blood there.
Ancient Battlefields

The ladder continues: Earth Immortal, Heaven Immortal, Golden Immortal, Taiyi Golden Immortal, Profound Sovereign and, at the summit of the Dao, Heavenly Lord.
Each realm is twice as mighty as the one before, and each needs more total levels of the Laws. No Heavenly Lord walks any world.
Past True Immortal

When you first join, you choose your bloodline, once and for good: Human, or one of the demon races (Tiger, Lizard, Fox or Dragon), each in three colourings.
A demon is born with a demon core, so its Demon Path and its heaven path have both already begun. Each race has its own gifts.
Bloodlines
Breakthroughs

Set your own years alight for strength. While they burn, your blows and spells hit 1.5 times as hard and you move faster, but your lifespan burns away quickly.
It switches itself off before it would leave you with too few years.
Burn Lifespan

Pills are brewed, not crafted. Make an Alchemy Cauldron from a cauldron, two copper ingots and a gold ingot (the mod's crafting recipes have their own tab in the recipe book).
- Fill it with a water bucket.
- Light a fire under it: fire, soul fire, a lit campfire, lava or a magma block.
- Right-click the cauldron with each ingredient, one at a time. An ingredient that fits no recipe is refused, so nothing is wasted.
Once the ingredients make a recipe, the water turns jade and brewing begins; when it finishes, the pill pops out. Right-click with an empty hand to see what's inside, or sneak and right-click to take the ingredients back out. Each pill's tooltip lists its ingredients.
The Alchemy Cauldron

The Immortal Realm's edge, where chaos from before heaven and earth still churns: floating shards that, farther out, merge into one wasteland.
- Its storm wears you down while you're unsheltered. A lit Law domain shelters you, and so does the light of the First Flame, whose spring lies far to the south.
- Chaos Fiends appear out of the air, stronger the deeper you go.
- Meditating in the First Flame's light comprehends a Law much faster.
The Chaos Frontier

Two treasures come from the Chaos Frontier:
- A Dao Fragment is a shard of one Law. An immortal can use it to gain half a level of insight into that Law.
- A Chaos Origin Stone is hardened chaos, the material of a small world's seed. Chaos Fiends drop them, and Chaos Origin Ore in the Frontier's land holds them.
Chaos Treasures

A demon clan is a sect of a single demon race, led by its Clan Head. It works like a sect: it has a barrier, a treasury and titles by strength. Its members are demons of that race, cultivating the Demon Path.
A clan only takes in demons of its own race.
Demon Clans

A technique for Nascent Soul and above, learned from its manual. Use it to split off a second body at the cost of half your qi; use it again to move into the clone while your main body sits in meditation.
The clone is you, at your own realm, but with half your strength.
Clone

Robes, guan, trousers and boots worn instead of armour, in five grades: Mortal, Spirit, Earth, Heaven and Immortal. Each grade protects as well as the matching tier of armour, and also speeds up your qi gathering and meditation.
Mortal clothing is crafted from wool and string, and each piece can be upgraded one grade at a time in the crafting grid, keeping its enchantments. Cultivators wear it too, and sometimes drop it.
Cultivator Clothing

This is your guide to cultivation. Press {codex} to open it at any time, or click the book beside the cultivation menu.
The Codex grows with you. Most pages are sealed at first and show only ???, with a hint of how to open them. Reach a new realm, learn a new art or set foot in a new world, and the pages about it open. A toast tells you when that happens, and a gold dot marks every page you haven't read yet.
Choose a chapter on the left, then a page from its list.
The Dao Codex

A last resort. Use it once and your core trembles as a warning; use it again within a few seconds and your core breaks, swells and bursts. The blast grows with your realm and tears through everything nearby.
You die, and your golden core is lost: you fall back to Foundation Building.
Core Detonation

Your qi condenses into a golden core. You can fly on your qi (Qi Flight, with Meteor Flight as its fast mode), see the qi of the world (Qi Sense), and you float while you meditate. Your core is also a last resort (Core Detonation).
To break through, you need a Nascent Soul method and to survive a harder tribulation. From here on, no pill is needed.
Core Formation

The Immortal Realm's court: the Heavenly King on the throne, five Heavenly Venerables in their halls, and the Immortal Generals at its gate.
Ask a Venerable to join its service. You earn merit by standing watch at the Southern Heavenly Gate, slaying devilish immortals and fighting the primordial beasts. Merit raises your rank from Officer to Captain and General, and the Quartermaster trades goods for it.
The Celestial Court

The world is full of cultivators: wandering rogues, hermits in seclusion, and sect disciples. Each has a realm (your consciousness domain shows it), a temperament and an alignment.
They live their own lives: they cultivate, travel, spar, trade and break through, and some of them die. Talk to them, and most will have something to tell you.
Cultivators

You become one with the Dao, and your might doubles again. Its methods are rare: only a few steles in the Jade Firmament's wondrous lands, and the few cultivators of this realm, can teach them.
In the lower realms your strength is still capped at Heavenly Being's.
Dao Integration

Death is not the end. When you die, you wake at the Ghost Gate in the Netherworld as a ghost: cyan light in your own likeness. You fly freely (double-tap {jump}) and can't touch anything in the living world.
Your items drop where you died. You keep everything you cultivated, but while you are dead you can only cultivate the ghost path (the heaven path and the Demon Path wait until you live again), and the dead cultivate it 1.5 times as fast as the living.
If you are struck down as a ghost, you scatter and re-form at the Gate.
Death

Every ten days the heavens judge an immortal, with a warning the day before. Five signs come a minute apart: your robes stain (your armour weakens), your flowers wither (nothing heals you), your qi falters (qi gathering is halved), your body sweats (your blows and spells weaken) and your mind can't rest (no meditation). Then comes the judgement: a storm of lightning.
Survive it and choose a level of the Laws. If it strikes you down, you live on, but one stage lower.
The Five Decays

Beasts with cultivation of their own roam the wilds, from Qi Refining up to Core Formation. They are as strong as cultivators of the same rank, and the stronger they are, the bigger they grow. Your consciousness domain shows their realm.
Each kind lives in its own lands and has its own way of fighting.
Demon Beasts

Tiger, Lizard, Fox and Dragon Blood, each of a certain realm, drunk like a potion. Demons of that race drop it, and so do wild beasts related to it.
- A demon can only drink its own race's blood, which opens the way for its Demon Path to break through.
- A human who drinks it forms a demon core and becomes a half-blood: human in looks, with half the race's gifts. Each drink makes the blood purer. A drink that would turn you completely into that race is refused with a warning, unless you drink it while sneaking. There is no way back.
Demon Blood

A slain demon beast may drop its demon core; the higher its rank, the more likely. A core records the beast's realm, stage and element, and its look shows its realm.
Beasts related to a demon race may also drop a phial of that race's blood.
Demon Cores

A third path beside the heaven path and the ghost path, with the same realms and stages and its own cultivation bar. You can walk it alongside the heaven path.
At a realm's Grand Perfection, the Demon Path can only break through once you have drunk your race's blood of the next realm, just as the heaven path needs a method.
The Demon Path

Your consciousness spreads around you as a domain, growing wider with every stage. Inside it you see every living thing outlined, even through walls, along with each cultivator's realm.
Realm Suppress (off until you switch it on) weighs down everything weaker than you inside your domain, at a cost in qi.
Consciousness Domain

Wood, water, fire, earth and metal. Every heaven method belongs to one element: it draws in that element's qi, and its spells are of that element too.
Your physique's spiritual roots decide which elements you can learn: a method whose element your roots reject won't take.
The Five Elements

Burn, and be reborn from the ashes. Cultivators of this realm gather on the Shore of Nirvana in the Great Void, waiting for the Immortal Gate to open.
The Gate's passage crushes all but the strongest: attempt it at Grand Perfection, well armoured and with healing at hand.
Entering Nirvana

A True Immortal's golden essence pool. It only fills in the Immortal Realm and drains away anywhere else. Switch on the Immortal Essence ability and your blows and spells hit harder while it lasts. Law domains use it up too.
Immortal Essence

Tools against the dead:
- A Peach Wood Sword hits the dead with full force, and twice as hard.
- An Inscription Brush paints talismans. The Ghost-Quelling Talisman, thrown, strikes the dead and binds them; the Yang Fire Talisman, burned, drives the Netherworld's yin out of your body.
- The Yang Preservation Pill stops yin corruption from rising; the Yin Gathering Pill, brewed from an Other-Shore Flower and a Netherworld Lotus, speeds up the ghost path.
Yin Jade, mined in the Netherworld, goes into the Ghost-Quelling Talisman, and the dead value it highly.
The Exorcist's Tools

Your foundation is laid. Your qi now sustains you, so you no longer get hungry. Hold a sword and you can ride it through the air (Sword Flight), and you can now refine a Storage Ring.
To break through, you need a Core Formation method, a Core Pill (Spirit Ginseng, Spirit Lotus, a Cultivation Fruit and Blaze Powder), and to survive a tribulation that calls for armour.
Foundation Building

Four Axis isn't climbed on qi alone. Each of its stages has an axis of virtue, and you can't break out of that stage until its axis is complete:
- Early, the Axis of Longevity: heal the sick and fading, and accept the years they can spare.
- Mid, the Axis of Fortune: bring people the goods they lack, and share in their fortune.
- Late, the Axis of Merit: slay whatever preys on the people.
- Grand Perfection, the Axis of Enlightenment: help lesser cultivators break through their bottlenecks.
These wishes come from the settlers on the Astral Realm's worlds: ask a settler about their wish.
The Four Axes

You stand upon the four axes of heaven and earth. Each stage of this realm has an axis of virtue to complete (see The Four Axes, in The Way of Cultivation), filled by granting the wishes of the lower realms' people.
Cultivation needs far more qi than ever before, so cultivate in the Jade Firmament, where qi is rich. In the lower realms your strength is capped at Heavenly Being's.
Four Axis

Cultivation Fruit is rare. It hangs under the leaves of wild trees and ages as the days pass: the older it is, the brighter its aura and the more qi it holds. Right-click it to pick it. A picked fruit keeps its age but grows no older.
Eating it gives cultivation, refined as you meditate. Now and then one leaves a Peach Pit, which grows into a Spirit Peach Tree of your own.
Cultivation Fruit

The Gate hangs in the Great Void's sky beyond the Shore of Nirvana. It opens every few days for a few minutes, and everyone is told a minute before.
Crossing it means climbing through its passage under crushing pressure: True Immortals cross unharmed, Entering Nirvana cultivators at Grand Perfection survive with care, and anyone weaker is crushed or turned back.
The Immortal Gate

A dead cultivator whose ghost path has reached Core Formation becomes a Ghost King: crowned, mighty, and a lord of the Netherworld. The heaven path never makes a king, however high it goes.
The Netherworld's own kings rule palaces and courts, and keep treasuries under their seal.
Ghost Kings

The path of the ghost methods, walked by both the dead and the living, with its own cultivation bar and its own tribulations. It begins with a ghost method, learned from a Ghost Jade Slip, a Method Stele, or a ghost cultivator willing to teach it.
The first method, the Netherworld Breathing Art, is carved on the stele on the Ghost Gate's plaza.
The living choose which qi they draw in with the Path button on the Cultivation tab.
The Ghost Path

The second kind of qi. It belongs to places, not to you: ghost methods are cultivated on it, and your ghostly qi pool fills from it. Under Qi Sense it appears as cyan yin motes.
It is thick in the Netherworld, thickest on the Nine Nether Peaks, and faint in soul sand valleys.
Ghostly Qi

On the Great Void's Ancient Battlefields, each pool of blood holds a phial of a demon race's blood. Come near, and that race's elder rises out of the pool to guard it: the Elder White Tiger, the Nine-Tailed Fox, the Mountain-Bearing Lizard King or the Azure Dragon.
They stay by their pools, and leave alone anyone a realm or more above them.
The Elder Beasts

Above the Jade Firmament: floating continents under a black-violet void full of stars, with a hundred times the lower realms' qi.
- Reach it through a Void Breach, torn high in the Jade Firmament's sky from Void Shattering on. A Dao Integration cultivator can only pass through a breach held open by someone stronger.
- The climb takes a while, through shattered space where no flight works, and the void presses on you all the way.
- To go back down, fall off a continent's edge or tear space.
Drifting rifts of starlight carry whoever touches them far across the void.
The Great Void
Heaven Methods

You rise above the mortal world, and can tear space itself open (Spatial Tear).
This is as high as anyone can climb in the lower realms: you can only break through to Four Axis above them, in the Jade Firmament (see Worlds Beyond).
Heavenly Being

Spirit herbs grow wild and age like fruit does: Ginseng and the rarer Spirit Ginseng, Lingzhi in dark forests, Huangjing, the Spirit Lotus on still water, and Spirit Dew Grass, which gathers beads of dew. Right-click a herb to dig it up. It keeps its age, and the older the herbs, the better the pills brewed from them.
A fully grown plant gives seeds when you dig it up. Purple Lingzhi and Ochre Huangjing are rare kinds that count as twice their age.
Spirit Herbs

The Great Void's sects. A Holy Land is a sect of white jade and gold, led by a Sacred Vessel Patriarch; a Demon Palace is the demons' version, of a single race, led by its Demon Sovereign.
Both are rare, and both take in disciples like any sect or clan.
Holy Lands

An endless sea of clouds with jade peaks rising out of it, under a golden sky, with a thousand times the lower realms' qi. Nobody below Entering Nirvana can enter.
Its cities and markets, its island sects and the Celestial Court are here. The only way back down is through the Gate while it is open. Far out, the land breaks up into chaos.
The Immortal Realm

Meditate for a while and your soul turns inward: you open your eyes on an island of your own in a void, while your body stays sitting where you left it. Meditation there is 1.5 times as effective.
Walk the island as you like, and press {meditate} to return to your body. If anything hits your body, you are pulled back at once.
You can switch it off on the Abilities tab if you'd rather stay where you sit.
The Inner Realm

Jade Ore is found in mountains, about as rare as diamonds; mine it with an iron pickaxe. Jade goes into the Foundation Pill, spirit pedestals, Storage Rings and more.
Blue Spirit Trees, spruces with blue qi flowing up their trunks, grow among the spruces of the taiga.
Jade and Spirit Wood

The Upper Realm: islands of jade-veined land under a jade sky, far richer in qi than the lower realms. Its sects are stronger, its herbs and spirit stones richer, and its steles teach higher methods.
Four Axis and Dao Integration are cultivated here.
The Jade Firmament

Ask any sect member to join. A disciple will send you to an elder, who judges you: most set an entrance trial, a spar that you must either win or last to the end. A gifted physique, or an elder whose regard for you is Warm, may let you in without one.
As a disciple you can pass the barrier, and you cultivate faster on the sect's grounds. Follow the treasury's rules: a thief is warned once, then expelled.
Joining a Sect

The mod's keys, all of which can be changed in Controls:
- {menu}: the cultivation menu
- {meditate}: start or stop meditating
- {circulate}: circulate qi (for the qi surge games)
- {abilities} (hold): the ability wheel
- {quick}: use your selected ability
- {spells} (hold): the spell wheel
- {cast}: cast your readied spell
- {ring}: open your Storage Ring
- {codex}: the Dao Codex
Keys

Once you comprehend a Law's first level, you awaken its domain: the Law's own ground spread out around you. Only one domain can be lit at a time, and it burns immortal essence. Foes inside it suffer the Law's effects, and your spells of that Law hit them harder.
Law Domains

Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth, and the greater Laws of Space, Time, and Life and Death, each with nine levels. Past True Immortal, every realm needs a certain total of Law levels.
- Meditate in the Immortal Realm to comprehend the Law you are focusing on.
- Slay strong foes with an element's spells for glimpses of that element's Law.
- Survive the Five Decays to gain a level of your choice.
Each Law strengthens its own arts. The greater Laws open at Golden Immortal. You'll find them on the Methods tab's Laws page.
The Laws

- Jade Slips: right-click one to read it. It teaches its method at once and isn't used up. Cultivators carry them, sect libraries keep them, and elders and rogues sell them to people they like.
- Dao Steles: carved stones in the wilds, rarer the higher their method. Meditate beside one for a while to learn its method.
- Teachers: a sect's elders and master, and rogues, may teach you their method once their regard for you is Warm.
Methods of different elements add together; for methods of the same element, only the highest counts.
Learning a Method

Everyone ages: one year for every day of play, starting from age sixteen. A mortal lives a hundred years, and each realm you reach adds more years, far more with every realm. The Stats tab shows your age and your lifespan.
Time is life: meditating at a faster pace costs years, and so do some arts. Longevity Pills give some years back.
When your years run out, the heavens send a storm to take your life. It only ends if you gain new years by breaking through into a new realm. If you die during it, you lose everything you have cultivated.
Lifespan

A Meditation Mat, or the finer Red Silk Meditation Mat, speeds up your meditation: right-click it to sit down and meditate.
A Spirit Pedestal holds one Cultivation Fruit or herb, floating above it. Place pedestals close around where you meditate and their qi feeds you: the older what they hold, the more it helps. Only the oldest few count.
Mats and Pedestals

Once you can cultivate, meditation is how you grow. Press {meditate} (or the Meditate button on the Cultivation tab) and keep still. Press it again, or move, to stop.
Meditation draws the world's qi into your cultivation. Some places are much richer in qi than others, and meditation mats, spirit pedestals, a spirit stone held in your hand and cultivator clothing all speed it up.
Now and then your qi surges: you hear a chime, and a small game appears around the crosshair. Play it with {circulate} to earn Qi Harmony, which speeds up your meditation for a while. If you ignore it, nothing is lost, but fail it badly and you suffer a qi deviation.
If you meditate long enough, your soul turns inward to your own Inner Realm.
Meditation

Press {menu} to open the cultivation menu. Its tabs:
- Cultivation: your realm and stage, the cultivation bar, and the Meditate and Breakthrough buttons.
- Stats: what your realm gives your body, and your stat points.
- Abilities: the abilities you have awakened, each with its own switch.
- Methods: the methods you know, and the one you practise.
- Spells: the spells your methods have taught you.
- Sect: your sect, once you belong to one.
- Journal: what you have heard from cultivators, and the events of your own story.
The Cultivation Menu

At Mortal Peak, drink a Marrow Cleansing Elixir. It opens your meridians, and you begin cultivating at Qi Refining Early, the first realm. The elixir only works at Mortal Peak.
Brew it in an Alchemy Cauldron from Ginseng, a Honey Bottle and two Bone Meal.
Ginseng grows wild on the ground: right-click a plant to dig it up.
Opening the Meridians

Qi Flight's fast mode, off until you switch it on. With it on, hold {forward} to fly where you look, and hold {sprint} to build up to your realm's top speed.
From Nascent Soul, you blaze across the sky and can smash through whatever stands in your way, if the world's settings allow it.
Meteor Flight

Everyone begins as a mortal, with no qi, no cultivation and no abilities. Meditation does nothing yet.
First you must temper your body through four stages: Mortal Low, Mid, High and Peak. Fighting, mining, sprinting and eating all temper it, and so does eating spirit herbs raw. The cultivation menu ({menu}) shows your progress, and each stage makes you a little stronger.
At Mortal Peak your body is ready to have its meridians opened. (Demons are born with a demon core and start at Qi Refining instead.)
A Mortal Body

A soul is born inside your core. It can leave your body (Soul Projection) and take over another body (Possession), and from this realm you can learn techniques (see Methods and Spells). Fly high enough and you can rise beyond the sky itself.
From Nascent Soul on, every stage needs a breakthrough with its own tribulation. Before you leave this realm, the heavens will ask you to name your obsession.
Nascent Soul

The realm of the dead: golden riverlands, fields of red spider lilies, wastes of ash and bone, and the dark Nine Nether Peaks, where ghostly qi is densest.
The Ghost Gate is its hub. Ghost cultivators wander it, Hungry Ghosts gather in the Bone Wastes, and Ghost Kings rule from their palaces.
The Netherworld

Before the tribulation from Nascent Soul into Heavenly Being, the heavens ask what your heart cannot let go of: Longevity, Fortune, Merit or Enlightenment.
Each gives its own boon, and at Four Axis it makes the axis of the same name faster to fill. You can only choose once, so read them all before you face the tribulation.
Name Your Obsession

Every cultivator is born with a physique. Yours was rolled when you first joined, announced in chat, and is shown on the Stats tab.
Its grade (Low, Mid, High, Supreme or Immortal) is your talent: the higher it is, the faster you cultivate and the fewer years meditation costs you. Many physiques also have special gifts, and every physique has spiritual roots, which decide which elements' methods you can learn.
The higher the grade, the rarer it is.
Your Physique

Brewed in the Alchemy Cauldron:
- Qi Gathering Pill: you gather more qi for a while.
- Cultivation Pill: gives cultivation, refined as you meditate.
- Foundation Pill and Core Pill: needed to break into Foundation Building and Core Formation.
- Longevity Pill: adds years of life; each one adds fewer than the last.
A pill comes out at Low, Mid, High, Supreme or Immortal grade: the older its herbs, the higher the grade and the stronger the pill.
Pills

A projected soul can take over a body at least one realm below yours: right-click it. In a cultivator's body you play as yourself, with everything it carries, and others see its face and name.
Let go, or call your soul home, to leave the body. If the body dies, your soul is thrown out unharmed.
Possession

The Immortal Realm's world bosses, one of each at a time: the Kun-Peng, the True Phoenix and the True Dragon, each stronger than a True Immortal at its peak. A fourth, the Primordial Chaos, lurks far out in the Chaos Frontier.
The Heavenly Venerables know where to find them, and the Court rewards those who fight them.
Primordial Beasts

Double-tap {jump} to fly on your qi, as freely as in creative mode. Flying uses up qi, and a young core's pool runs dry quickly, so keep an eye on it and land before it empties. In the Jade Firmament, and from Heavenly Being on, it never runs out.
Meteor Flight is its fast mode.
Qi Flight

The first realm: your meridians are open, and qi flows through them.
- Meditate, and learn a heaven method (see Methods and Spells).
- At Qi Refining Mid, perform the Ritual to the Heavens.
- You already have your consciousness domain, Realm Suppress, Burn Lifespan and the Inner Realm (see Abilities).
To break through at Grand Perfection, you need a Foundation Building method, a Foundation Pill (brewed from Ginseng, Lingzhi, Spirit Ginseng and Jade), and to survive a weak tribulation.
Qi Refining

You can see the plane of qi. While Qi Sense is on, the world turns grey and its qi appears as motes in the colours of their elements, crowded where qi is thick. Spirit treasures keep their colours.
Switch it off on the Abilities tab or the wheel to see the world normally again.
Qi Sense

Every cultivator has a regard for you, ranging from Hostile through Polite, Courteous, Warm and Trusted up to Sworn. Greetings, gifts and spars raise it; provoking or harming them lowers it.
The warmer their regard, the better their prices, and the more they will sell you and teach you.
Regard

- The Wheel of Reincarnation, across the bridge from the Gate: use its hub to return to life at your spawn point. Nothing a ghost carries comes back with it.
- Meng Po's soup, by the bridge: drink it before the Wheel, and your medicinal toxicity is cleared when you live again.
- The Terrace for Gazing Homeward: from its top, a ghost can see where it died.
Coming Back

Your title in a sect depends on your strength compared with its members: Outer Disciple, Inner Disciple, Elder or Grand Elder. It changes as you, or they, break through. Elders may open the treasury.
The Sect tab shows your sect, your title, the sect's regard for you, and its members.
Rising in a Sect

At Qi Refining Mid your bar fills up and stops: to go further, you need the heavens' permission to cultivate.
- Craft a Heaven Altar (smooth stone, jade, a Low-grade spirit stone and copper), place it under the open sky, and build around it: a grander altar earns more favour.
- Right-click it and place your offerings in its ring. The dial shows your chance of success; richer offerings raise it.
- Sneak and right-click it with an empty hand to begin, then kneel still until the heavens answer.
If they stay silent, your offering is still used up, and you can try again from the next dawn.
Ritual to the Heavens

You temper yourself into a vessel for the heavens' power. The Patriarchs of the Holy Lands and the Sovereigns of the Demon Palaces are of this realm, and few others in the world.
Its methods are among the rarest of all: look for them in the Great Void and in the Jade Firmament's most wondrous lands.
Sacred Vessel

Five treasures from the old tales, one for each element: the Jianmu Bough Vase, the Heaven Furnace Censer, the Nine Provinces Ding, the Immortal-Forging Bell and the Sealed Ocean Gourd.
Each lies on a relic altar in the Great Void, and a guardian rises to protect it from anyone who comes near. Held in your hand, a vessel makes spells of its element hit harder.
Sacred Vessels

Sects are villages of cultivators built around a main hall, protected by the barrier of their Formation Core. A gate stands on the road in, watched by gate guards, and the members follow a daily routine of lectures, practice, sleep and night watch.
A sect's library keeps jade slips, and its sealed treasury holds its riches. Members are ranked by strength, from Outer Disciples up to the Sect Master. Demon clans live the same way, each made up of a single race.
Sects
At the edge of the Great Void's sea, a camp of Entering Nirvana hermits and old monsters waits for the Immortal Gate. They trade, and are rarely hostile.
The Shore of Nirvana

An immortal's own world: a floating island under the stars. Craft a World Seed from five Chaos Origin Stones and four Immortal Jade, then, as a True Immortal, hold it in use to refine it.
After that, you can open its door wherever you stand, for yourself and the guests you allow.
Small Worlds

Your soul can leave your body. Switch Soul Projection on while standing on steady, dry ground and keep still for a few seconds, and your soul rises out. Your body stays sitting where you left it, and any harm done to it is done to you.
Your soul flies freely on a tether to your body, unseen except by those who can perceive souls. Switch the ability again to call it home.
Soul Projection

The living reach the Netherworld through the Gate of the Yellow Springs, a rift at the very centre of the Nether: walk into it, and the Soul River carries you up to the Ghost Gate.
To go back down, use the rift on the Gate's plaza.
The Soul River

Ask a cultivator to spar: a friendly bout with pulled blows that ends when one side drops to half health, not a fight to the death. You can bet spirit stones on it.
Winning spars earns respect, and some sects' entrance trials are spars.
Sparring

Between the Overworld and the Jade Firmament lies the Spatial Gap, a sea of torn space. A rift at the very centre of the Overworld leads into it, and so does a Spatial Tear.
Anyone who can fly flies freely there; anyone who can't falls back out. Every block you cross in the gap counts as many blocks in the world. Its pressure and storms wear you down the whole time, so bring healing.
Rise through its upper layers to come out in the Jade Firmament; sink through its floor and you fall into the Overworld's sky.
The Spatial Gap

Tear space open: a rift appears in front of you and stays open for a while, and anyone can walk through it. Its rim shows where it leads: violet into the Spatial Gap, green out to the Overworld, gold out to the Jade Firmament.
Each tear costs part of your qi.
The Spatial Tear

Your methods teach spells as their layers settle in; you'll find them on the Spells tab.
Ready a spell there, or hold {spells} to open the spell wheel and pick one, then press {cast} to cast it. Spells cost qi, and each has a cooldown before it can be cast again. Arrange the spell wheel on the Spells tab.
The higher your realm, the farther and wider your spells reach. Whether spells permanently change the land is a world setting, which an operator can switch at the bottom of the Spells tab.
Spells

From Foundation Building on, each realm has one spell that belongs to both the heaven path and the Demon Path. You can use it once both of those paths have reached its realm.
Only the living can cast these spells, and they use your qi.
Spells of Both Paths

Spirit stones are heaven and earth's qi condensed into stone: the cultivators' money, and a store of qi. There are five grades (Low, Mid, High, Supreme and Immortal), each worth nine of the grade below. Nine stones craft into one of the next grade, and one breaks back down into nine.
- Hold right-click to absorb a stone's qi into your pool.
- Meditate with one in your hand to cultivate faster while its qi lasts.
They are mined from spirit stone veins in the Overworld's stone (the richer veins lie deepest), and cultivators carry them.
Spirit Stones

Cultivation climbs through realms, and each realm has four stages: Early, Mid, Late and Grand Perfection. Meditation fills the cultivation bar on the Cultivation tab.
Below Nascent Soul, a full bar moves you up to the next stage automatically. Grand Perfection is a realm's peak: there the bar stays full until you break through into the next realm. From Nascent Soul on, every new stage needs a breakthrough too.
Each realm makes your body far stronger than the last, and many bring new abilities.
Your qi is shown at the top left of the screen. Abilities, flight and spells use it up, and it refills as you gather qi.
Realms and Stages

Each stage you reach gives you stat points, and each new realm gives more. Spend them on the Stats tab's Stat Points page, across six stats: Strength, Constitution, Agility, Endurance, Spirit and Insight.
Stat points belong to you, not to one path: every path you walk shares them. If you fall back, the points you spent last are taken back first.
Stat Points

A Storage Ring folds a pocket of space into a ring. Craft one from four gold ingots, four jade and an ender pearl.
Right-click to open it, sneak and right-click to wear it, and press {ring} to open the one you're wearing. Whatever it holds stays inside, wherever the ring goes.
Refine it (the button at the top right of its screen) to raise its grade and its capacity. Each grade needs spirit stones, a few rarer items and a higher realm, starting at Foundation Building; the highest grade has no limit.
Storage Rings

Hold any sword in your main hand and double-tap {jump}: the sword lies flat under your feet and carries you through the air. It costs little qi, but it is slow, and no realm makes it faster.
Only one of Sword Flight and Qi Flight can be switched on at a time.
Sword Flight

Right-click a cultivator to talk. The talk wheel offers Greet, Ask, Spar, Trade, Gift and Provoke.
- Ask: about them, their sect, rumours, and what they could teach or sell you.
- Trade: buy and sell for spirit stones.
- Gift: give them something they value to raise their regard for you.
Mind your manners with cultivators far above your realm.
Talking

Techniques are arts learned from a Technique Manual, rather than gained with a realm. Sects keep these manuals in their masters' halls, and more rarely in their libraries.
Read a manual at its realm and the technique is yours for good. The manual isn't used up, so you can pass it on; if you're below its realm, it tells you which realm you need.
The first technique is Clone (see Abilities).
Techniques
From Void Shattering on, you can take a title of your own: type it into the field on the Cultivation tab and press Enter. It is announced to the whole world and shown above your name.
A Title of Your Own

Breaking into a new realm calls down a heavenly tribulation: a storm gathers over you and strikes you with lightning again and again. From Nascent Soul on, every new stage brings one too.
Survive every strike and the breakthrough succeeds. If the lightning kills you, you die and also drop back a stage.
The higher the realm, the more strikes there are and the harder they hit. The first one is easy; after that, wear good armour or cultivator clothing with Protection enchantments, and later bring potions as well. Keep your health high.
Tribulations

Immortality: your years have no end. From now on you can only break through in the Immortal Realm, and no method can take you higher: the Laws do (see Laws and Immortality).
Your immortal essence only fills in the Immortal Realm. And every ten days, the Five Decays come for you.
True Immortal

Neither path builds on the other, but someone who walks both is stronger than someone who walks only one. Your body follows the stronger of the two, and the other adds its share.
The living get the heaven path's full strength and part of the ghost path's; for the dead, it is the other way round.
The Two Paths

Cultivation Pills and Cultivation Fruit give cultivation, but not all at once. Their qi waits beside your cultivation bar, unrefined, and meditating turns it into cultivation.
Each pill or fruit you take makes the next one weaker for a while. This medicinal toxicity fades over time; the cultivation menu and the tooltips show how much you have.
While your bar is full at a realm's peak, nothing is refined, but nothing is lost either.
Unrefined Qi

You shatter the void: the lower realms no longer hold you back, and you keep your full strength everywhere.
- Tear space high in the Jade Firmament's sky to open a Void Breach into the Great Void (see Worlds Beyond).
- Take a title of your own on the Cultivation tab; it is announced to the whole world.
Cultivating this realm needs the Great Void's dense qi: anywhere else it is many times slower.
Void Shattering

Your abilities are listed on the Abilities tab, each with its own switch, and placed on the ability wheel. Hold {abilities}, point toward a slot and click to select it; click it again, right-click, or press its number to switch it on or off (or to use it, for one-time abilities).
{quick} uses your selected ability without opening the wheel. You can rearrange the wheel on the Abilities tab.
New abilities awaken as you climb the realms.
The Ability Wheel

A living body in the Netherworld fills up with its yin, shown by the Yin Corruption bar under your qi. Frost creeps in from the edges of the screen as it rises, with warnings along the way.
When it is full, your body gives way and you become a ghost where you stand. Outside the Netherworld it slowly drains away.
Yin Corruption

cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.axi: (Your axis stands complete: break through before you seek the next.)
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.giv: You already carry enough of others' fortune to complete your axis. Take it into yourself first; we would not have you carry what you don't need.
You've saved us. Take these, it's little enough: %s Mid-grade Spirit Stones, a share of all we have. (Absorb them to fill your Axis of Fortune.)
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.gui: Sit with me in meditation, close by. (%s seconds more)
Guided by you, %s breaks through to %s.
From within, you carry %s through its wall to %s.
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.hea: (Healing them takes %s%% of your qi, and you haven't that much now.)
They breathe easy, colour in their face again. They owe you their life: %s years they could give you, if you would take them.
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.non: We want for nothing now, thanks to you. Perhaps some other day.
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.not: (Only one of Four Axis could grant it.)
(Only one of Four Axis could grant it: of the dead, one whose ghost path is.)
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.oth: (It would serve the %s, not the axis you stand at.)
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.say: I have sat at the same wall for years. I can feel the way through and cannot take it.
My cultivation is stuck. If someone far above me would sit with me only once...
There is no master on this world. I have gone as far as I can alone.
Our stores are bare and the season turns against us. If only we had %s %s.
We came here with too little. %s %s would see us through.
The traders stopped coming. We need %s %s, and no one here can spare them.
My mother lies sick, and fades more each day. No herb of ours can touch it.
My brother took a fever three nights ago and has not woken since.
Our elder is dying. Without her we would not know how to live on this world.
A great beast comes out of the wilds at night and tramples everything in its way. We cannot stand against it.
A brood of great spiders nests in the hills. They take whatever strays from the village.
Witches have made their home nearby. Our children sicken, and our well tastes of their brews.
A cultivator of the devilish path has made us a hunting ground. Each moon one of us is taken for a cauldron.
Riders of bone come out of the storms. Whoever they pass falls down dead.
Something that wears many faces haunts the woods. Those who follow it come back blind, or not at all.
A wolf pack has learned how easy our flocks are. Soon it will learn how easy we are.
Raiders come every few nights and take what we have grown. Next time they will take us.
Raiders ride a great beast down on us and take whatever they like. We cannot stand against them.
A sorcerer haunts the land past our fields. Two of ours went out and did not come back.
The dead walk out of the old barrows, and they no longer rest even by day.
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.tak: Take all they can spare (%s years).
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.thr: What preyed on %s's people is gone, but not by your hand: their wish still stands.
It is out there now, and it has your scent. Kill it and we are free of it.
They are out there now, %s of them, and they have your scent. Kill them all and we are free of them.
The threat to %s's people is slain.
cultivation.defying-the-heavens.wish.too: It is fair, for a life. %s years are yours.
You ask for nothing? We will never forget you.

gamerule.netherworldAfterDeath: The dead go to the Netherworld
gamerule.netherworldAfterDeath.descripti: Players who die wake at the Ghost Gate as ghosts, and return to life at the Wheel of Reincarnation.
gamerule.spellGriefing: Spells change the land for good
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.ghost_c: The third foundation, the Ghost Kings' own: gather the yin into a core of cold fire. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Core Formation, where the dead are kings.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 21: Ghost Core Burst. Layer 25: King's Decree. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.ghost_f: Cold fire drawn out of yin, that burns the dead worst of all. A ghost's blows strike harder.

Your ghost path opens its layers: 1-3 at Qi Refining, 4-6 at Foundation Building, 7-9 at Core Formation. Layer 1: Ghost Fire. Layer 4: Ghost Fire Bolt. Layer 7: the fire leaps to a second foe. Every layer: a ghost's blows +10%.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.hell_fo: The ninth foundation: the soul forged in the fires of the lowest hell into a vessel no heaven can break. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Sacred Vessel.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 75: Mirror of Retribution. Layer 79: Soul-Locking Pagoda. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.netherw: The first foundation of the ghost cultivators: breathe the Netherworld's yin and keep it. It carries your ghost path through Qi Refining, with a deeper ghost qi pool, a ghost's hearts, and longer among the dead for the living.
Qi Refining: layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 3: Ghost Eye. Layer 5: Ghostly Wail. Layer 6: Netherworld Veil. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
The last foundation, written by the Chief Judge's own hand: the dead's way to immortality. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining all the way through True Immortal.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 93: Fengdu's Walls Rise. Layer 97: Ten Thousand Souls Ascend. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.nine_ne: The fourth foundation, out of the depths of the Nine Nethers: a soul born again of yin. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Nascent Soul.
Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 30: Soul Rend. Layer 34: Nine Nether Step. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.six_pat: The sixth foundation, the law of the Wheel itself: the six paths of rebirth turn within you. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining all the way through Four Axis.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 48: Wheel of Samsara. Layer 52: Six Paths Annihilation. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.ten_tho: The seventh foundation: the yin of every soul that ever passed the Ghost Gate, gathered into one Dao and made your own. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Dao Integration.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 57: Procession of Ten Thousand Ghosts. Layer 61: Gate of Ten Thousand Ghosts. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.underwo: The tenth foundation: to die a last time in the Nine Nethers and come out of it beyond death. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Entering Nirvana.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 84: Black and White Impermanence. Layer 88: Book of Life and Death. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.void_re: The eighth foundation: a ghost's hand closes on the void between the realms and tears it like cloth. Only a handful have ever read it. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Void Shattering.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 66: Rift to the Nine Nethers. Layer 70: Bridge of No Return. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.wanderi: How the dead drift where the wind goes. A ghost moves swifter.

Your ghost path opens its layers: 1-3 at Qi Refining, 4-6 at Foundation Building, 7-9 at Core Formation. Layer 1: Yin Wind Steps. Layer 2: Soul Dash. Layers 4-9: the free flight of the dead and of a Ghost King's form +10% swifter each (+60% at 9). Every layer: a ghost +3% speed.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.yama_ju: The fifth foundation, the Judges' own: weigh souls as the courts of the underworld weigh them. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Heavenly Being.
Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 39: Yama's Verdict. Layer 43: Chains of Hell. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.yellow_: The second foundation: steep the bones in the Yellow Springs' waters until the marrow runs with yin. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Foundation Building.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 12: Yellow Springs Tide. Layer 16: Marrow Ward. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.abyssa: Somewhere below the deepest sea the water runs out into the void, and the tide goes on without it. This canon is that tide: it breaks on the walls between the realms and wears them through.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Weak Water from the Void (layer 66) and Kun Rises from the Northern Abyss (70); and it teaches the water spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.ancien: Carved into the bark of a cypress that outlived three dynasties, this art teaches the cultivator to grow ring upon ring and endure every storm, and to scatter thorns among its roots for whatever comes to fell it.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Thousand Leaf Storm (layer 21), Ancient Bark Skin (layer 25). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.boundl: The canon of the waters that ring the world at its four axes, from which every river comes and to which every river returns. At its end lies the abyss of the north, where even time stands frozen.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Absolute Zero (layer 48), Boundless Sea (layer 52). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.buried: A world buried and forgotten beneath another, and alive still under the soil. Its reader goes into the grave whole and comes out of it beyond death's reach.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Gravestone Falls (layer 84) and Buried World (88); and it teaches the earth spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.clear_: Written beside a fount that never froze and never failed. It teaches qi to rise from deep in the body as spring water rises from the rock, washing every impurity away as it climbs.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Rain Call (layer 11), Water Prison (layer 14), Torrential Spring (layer 17). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.coilin: A recluse left it in a ruined mountain shrine after watching wild vines pull the shrine's walls down over forty springs. It teaches qi to climb, to coil and never to let go.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Life Force Drain (layer 11), Life Force Gain (layer 14), Mysterious Bristle Prison (layer 17). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.crimso: Written by an alchemist who held that a golden core is only ore until it is smelted. The body becomes a crucible, and the core is poured from fire refined nine times over, until it blooms like a lotus in the flame.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Crimson Swirl (layer 21), Solar Field (layer 25). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.ember_: A hearth-keeper's method handed down in mountain villages. Breath is banked in the dantian like coals under ash at night and fanned again at dawn, so that even the smallest ember of qi never goes out.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Flame Bolt (layer 2), Flame Fist (layer 5), Crimson Tempering (layer 8). Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.eterna: Recited in the peach gardens of the immortals, where spring never yields to autumn. Here life renews itself without pause and mends the wounds of all it shelters, and what it cannot grow it takes, as the strangler fig takes its host.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heaven-Piercing Bamboo (layer 39), Spring of Myriad Life (layer 43). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.evergr: The canon of the first immortal of wood, who planted a single seed at the gate of the immortal realm and waited a hundred thousand years in its shade. Its green never fades, and neither does its reader.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Primal Wind of Creation (layer 93) and First Seed of Creation (97); and it teaches the wood spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.five_s: The five sacred mountains stand at the four quarters and the centre of the land. This classic teaches the cultivator to gather their weight into a single core that nothing under heaven can shift.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Dragon Surge (layer 21), Mountain Stance (layer 25). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.four_p: When Mount Buzhou broke and the sky tilted, four pillars were raised at the ends of the world to hold heaven up again. This scripture is found only above the clouds, and is said to be cut into the stone of those pillars themselves.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earthen Titan (layer 48), Mountain Seal (layer 52). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.four_s: The Metal at the four axes of the world, forged into four swords that stand at the gates of creation. Whoever enters their array is never let out, and whoever wears this Canon's golden body is broken by no single blow.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heaven-Severing Sword (layer 48), Four Swords Array (layer 52). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.frozen: The moon's reflection in a frozen lake: there and not there, and never touched by time. Its reader passes through death as moonlight passes through ice.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Frozen Moon in the Well (layer 84) and The Frozen Moon Falls (88); and it teaches the water spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.furnac: The foundation is laid as the floor of a furnace beneath the heart. Breath works the bellows, each layer tempers the furnace walls, and whatever is thrown into its fire is refined, not lost.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Remote Yang Bomb (layer 11), Flame Armour (layer 14), Fire Serpent (layer 17). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.golden: Said to be copied from the marks the three-legged golden crow left on the great mulberry of the eastern sea before it carried the sun across the sky. Its practitioners learn to bear a sun within them, as bright as noon.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Phoenix Descent (layer 39), Sea of Flames (layer 43). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.

Left in a cave beneath the Thunder Peaks by a sword cultivator who let heaven's lightning hammer his core like an anvil until it rang gold. Its practitioners point and armour splits; they open their hand and the thunder leaps.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Sword Rain (layer 21), Golden Bell Shield (layer 25). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.green_: Village hermits copied this primer from the margins of an old almanac. It teaches you to breathe the way a seed breathes when it splits its husk, drawing green qi up from the soil through the soles of the feet; humble and patient, it is the root every Wood art grows from.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Wood Bullet (layer 2), Emerald Healing Art (layer 5), Verdant Growth (layer 8). Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.heaven: The root-script of the tree that stood where the four axes meet before heaven and earth were parted, bearing the sky upon its branches. Whoever completes it carries a world within their trunk, and all beneath its shade are kept.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Myriad Vine Binding (layer 48), World Tree (layer 52). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.

The highest fire under the four axes of heaven, the fire of the phoenix that burns itself to ash and rises again. Its masters set storms of flame loose across the sky and, once in a long while, refuse death itself.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Nine Suns Descend (layer 48), Phoenix Nirvana (layer 52). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
Heaven and earth are a furnace and all things in them its ore. This sutra teaches the body to be the furnace's vessel: whatever enters it is refined, and nothing breaks it.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Wind-Fire Wheels (layer 75) and Eight Trigrams Furnace (79); and it teaches the fire spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.

Recovered from the deepest grave of the Ancient Sword Graveyard, a scripture of the edge that cuts even karma, severing whatever heaven has granted. At its height the practitioner calls down the swords of every master buried there.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Mountain Cleave (layer 39), Sword Domain (layer 43). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
A sword canon of the immortals, said to have been written with the blade that cut heaven from earth. Its reader may cut down a heaven, should one stand in the way.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Heaven-Slaying Sword Rises (layer 93) and Primal Axe Splits Chaos (97); and it teaches the metal spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
Said to be copied from the starry river that divides the sky. It teaches qi to fall from the heavens with the whole weight of the celestial current behind it, and to drown whatever it closes over.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heavenly River Torrent (layer 39), Frozen Field (layer 43). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.houtu_: The canon of Houtu, Queen of the Earth, who keeps the ground every realm stands on and every soul returns to. Her immortals do not fall: the earth itself holds them up.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Hand of Houtu (layer 93) and Falling Continent (97); and it teaches the earth spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.hundre: The foundation is folded a hundred times like sword steel and laid about a lodestone heart. Iron leans toward its practitioner, and the weapons of others grow heavy in their hands.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Boulder Cleave (layer 11), Mineral Purification (layer 14), Advanced Flying Sword Technique (layer 17). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
All the rivers of all the realms, followed to the one sea they share, and that sea to the Dao. Its reader's qi stops being water and becomes the way water goes.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Black Tortoise Bastion (layer 57) and Hundred Rivers Converge (61); and it teaches the water spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.immort: The art of the old smiths who laid their own bodies on their anvils and hammered them until they rang like bells. What is left is a vessel no blade can scratch.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Immortal-Binding Golden Ropes (layer 75) and Golden Dragon Scissors (79); and it teaches the metal spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.jianmu: The Jianmu, the tree that once joined earth to heaven, up whose trunk the gods came and went. This sutra makes the body such a trunk: a sacred vessel through which heaven's qi climbs without end.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Heaven-Swallowing Gourd (layer 75) and Seven-Treasure Bodhi Branch (79); and it teaches the wood spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.moon_m: Composed by a recluse who sat for a hundred years beside a lake so still that it held the moon twice. The sutra teaches the heart to become still water, reflecting all things and holding none.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Glacial Spears (layer 30), Great Tide (layer 34). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.mornin: A humble breathing art of river hermits. You sit among wet grass before sunrise and draw in the cold qi that settles with the dew, until your meridians run as clear as a mountain brook.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Water Arrow (layer 2), Azure Coating Technique (layer 5), Azure Breathing Technique (layer 8). Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.myriad: Myriad Swords Return to the Dao Scripture
Ten thousand swords, forged by ten thousand hands in ten thousand realms, all returning to the one edge they were made from. Its reader's every gesture is that edge.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: White Tiger's Pounce (layer 57) and Myriad Swords Return to One (61); and it teaches the metal spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
Myriad Woods Return to Dao Scripture

When every forest of every world is seen as one tree, and that tree as the Dao itself putting out leaves, the cultivator's roots go down into heaven's own law. Its few readers say the scripture grows a page each spring.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Azure Dragon (layer 57) and Myriad Woods Return to the Dao (61); and it teaches the wood spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.nine_b: The nascent soul is cast like a great bell with nine swords hung inside it. When it tolls, every blade answers, and all who hear it share one another's wounds.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Piercing Sword Light (layer 30), Vajra Body (layer 34). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
A record of the great river that turns nine times on its way to the sea, never contending with the mountains yet wearing them all away. From it the cultivator learns to bend, to coil and to carry.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Tidal Lance (layer 21), Mist Veil (layer 25). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.nine_c: The nine cauldrons the first sovereign cast to hold the nine provinces of the world. The sutra makes the body a tenth: a sacred vessel with a land held within it.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Xirang, the Self-Growing Soil (layer 75) and Nine Cauldrons Suppress the Land (79); and it teaches the earth spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.one_fl: Every fire under heaven, from the candle to the sun, is the one flame burning in different places. This scripture finds it in the reader's heart and lets the Dao burn there.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Vermilion Bird's Descent (layer 57) and One Flame Burns the Heavens (61); and it teaches the fire spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.primal: The fire that lit the first dawn, kept by the Flame Emperor at the gate of the immortal realm. Those who read it carry a sun within them that never sets.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Samadhi True Fire (layer 93) and First Flame Before Heaven (97); and it teaches the fire spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.primev: The canon of a forest sect whose elders sat beneath the trees so long that none could say where their meridians ended and the roots began. Its cultivator becomes a whole wood, drowsy with blossom and bristling with thorns.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Thorn Spear Forest (layer 30), Lotus of Rebirth (layer 34). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.primor: Before heaven and earth there were only the waters, dark and without end. The immortals who read this canon remember them, and the first sea answers when they call.

Qi Refining to True Immortal, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Glacier of the First Age (layer 93) and The Primordial Sea (97); and it teaches the water spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.rammed: A village builder's manual, its pages stiff with dried clay. It teaches the body to take in the soil's qi one layer at a time, packed hard, the way earth is rammed between boards to raise a wall.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Spear (layer 2), Hardened Body (layer 5), Dirt Tide (layer 8). Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.sealed: An ocean sealed in a gourd no bigger than a thumb, carried for ten thousand years by the one cultivator who could bear its weight. The sutra teaches the body to be that gourd.

Qi Refining to Sacred Vessel, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Twenty-Four Sea-Fixing Pearls (layer 75) and Ocean-Sealing Vase (79); and it teaches the water spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.sovere: Sovereign Earth carries every mountain, river and living thing and never once complains of the weight. Those who recite this sutra learn to bear what others cannot, and to become the ground beneath their companions' feet.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Falling Mountain (layer 39), Heavy Earth Seal (layer 43). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.sword_: The sword is broken, and the heart is the sword now. Its reader dies by their own blade and is reforged in the dying, sharper than before.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Sword Tomb Awakens (layer 84) and Nine Rebirths of the Sword (88); and it teaches the metal spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.ten_th: Ten Thousand Mountains Return to One Scripture
All the mountains of all the realms are one mountain whose foot is everywhere. This scripture gathers them into the reader's dantian, and the Dao rests upon them.

Qi Refining to Dao Integration, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Qilin Tramples the Land (layer 57) and Seal of Ten Thousand Mountains (61); and it teaches the earth spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.thousa: Copied from a cliff face by a hermit who read the strata like the pages of a book. It records stone laid on stone over ten thousand years, each layer pressing the one beneath into something harder.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Wall Technique (layer 11), Boulder Throw (layer 14), Cave Formation (layer 17). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.undyin: When the phoenix burns, one ember is left that never goes out. Its reader becomes that ember, and every death after is only a fire that has not yet caught.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Undying Ember (layer 84) and Pyre of the Heavens (88); and it teaches the fire spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.vermil: The Nascent Soul is hatched in the fire of the south and takes the shape of the Vermilion Bird, guardian of the summer quarter of the sky. Its talons sear what they touch, and its descent sets the plains alight.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Karmic Fire (layer 30), Blazing Meteor (layer 34). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.void_b: A lotus of flame that grows where there is nothing to burn, and so burns the void itself. Its masters leave holes in the world where they have walked.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Golden Crow Descends (layer 66) and Sun Pulled Through the Void (70); and it teaches the fire spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.void_r: A tree whose roots hang in the void between the realms and drink from nothing. Its masters grow through the walls of the world as a root splits stone, and stand where there is no ground at all.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Spring Thunder of the Azure Emperor (layer 66) and Void Withering (70); and it teaches the wood spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.void_s: A stroke so sharp it cuts not the foe but the space the foe stands in. Its masters have walked between the realms along the lines they cut.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Void-Severing Sword Light (layer 66) and Ten-Direction Sword Prison (70); and it teaches the metal spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.whetst: A smith's apprentice's manual, its pages black with forge soot: grind your qi as a whetstone grinds iron and hang it about the body like an iron bell, until one thread of it grows keen enough to fly out and come home.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Flying Sword (layer 2), Blade Polish (layer 5), Steel Hurricane (layer 8). Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.wither: One half of the tree withered, the other in flower, and neither ever changing. To read it is to die and bloom in the same breath, until death no longer knows which half is yours.

Qi Refining to Entering Nirvana, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Seed of Withering Rebirth (layer 84) and Withering and Flourishing (88); and it teaches the wood spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.world_: The ground beneath the ground, the floor of the world itself. Its masters stand upon it, and when they stamp, realms crack like plates.

Qi Refining to Void Shattering, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its own realm's spells: Buzhou Falls (layer 66) and Earth Veins Lock the Void (70); and it teaches the earth spells of every realm below it. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.yellow: Beneath every mountain run the earth's veins, and in them sleeps the Yellow Dragon of the Centre. This canon teaches the nascent soul to swim those veins beside it, and to wake it.
