Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Summon Golem (layer 30), Earthquake (layer 34). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
item.defying-the-heavens.cultivation_fru: Eat for up to %s unrefined qi
physique.defying-the-heavens.ancient_hol: A body of the ancient sages: health and strength 1.3 times another's, a tribulation's strikes a quarter weaker, and its tempering twice as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.blessed_mer: Wide, clean meridians: qi gathers 1.5 times as fast into a pool 1.5 times as deep, and Qi Sense opens from a mortal's first day.
physique.defying-the-heavens.blood_demon: It feeds on the blood it spills: every blow it deals heals it by 15%% of the harm done.
physique.defying-the-heavens.cursed_meri: Meridians that leak: qi gathers 0.8 times as fast into a pool 0.8 times as deep.
physique.defying-the-heavens.eternal_rei: The rarest of all, and no gift to cultivation: a Low grade's talent and pace. A soul that never forgets: when its life is spent or its soul scatters, it is born again with this same body and all its cultivation, every realm, stage and method on each path, its years begun anew (a Rebirth Pill has no hold on it). Whoever keeps at it reaches True Immortal in the end.
physique.defying-the-heavens.fallen_true: An immortal reborn in a mortal body: any element, five times the pace on both paths, and a method's new layers need no settling.
physique.defying-the-heavens.five_elemen: Roots of all five elements: any element's methods may be learned, at the ordinary pace.
physique.defying-the-heavens.ghost_devil: Half the dead's already: the ghost path at twice the pace, and a Ghost King's form of its own anywhere, even among the living, as strong as its ghost methods allow. In that form it has the whole of its ghost path's strength, as the dead do; in its human form, half, as any living cultivator's ghost path gives. Find a ghost method of a deeper realm and the ghost path leaps to it.
physique.defying-the-heavens.heaven_defy: The heavens can't strike it down: a tribulation's killing strike leaves it one heart, and the tribulation fails instead. No failed tribulation costs it a stage or its cultivation: it may face the heavens again at once. It asks no leave of the heavens (no Ritual to the Heavens), but heaven methods come to it at 0.75 times the pace, and the righteous sense something wrong in it (-15 regard).
physique.defying-the-heavens.heaven_sacr: The heavens favour it: no Ritual to the Heavens is wanted at Qi Refining Mid, and heaven methods are cultivated 1.2 times as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.heavenly_th: A tribulation's lightning feeds it instead of harming it: every bolt taken becomes cultivation and qi.
physique.defying-the-heavens.hundred_ref: Refined in a hundred fires: one stat point more at every breakthrough.
physique.defying-the-heavens.innate_alch: Pills and elixirs brewed by its hands work twice as strongly.
physique.defying-the-heavens.innate_cons: A Consciousness Domain as wide as a Four Axis cultivator's the day it opens. It never grows past that.
physique.defying-the-heavens.jade_poison: No medicinal toxicity ever builds up, and the qi of pills and spirit fruit is refined the moment it is taken. No poison nor wither takes hold of it, and its blows poison what they strike, the more strongly the higher its realm.
physique.defying-the-heavens.myriad_form: As rare as the Eternal Reincarnation Body: born with two more physiques at once, of Mid to Supreme grade and never two that clash, with all their gifts.
physique.defying-the-heavens.nine_yang_b: A body of the blazing sun: fire and lava never burn it. Heaven methods are cultivated 1.3 times as fast; the ghost path, yin to its yang, at half the pace.
physique.defying-the-heavens.primordial_: The chaos from before heaven and earth parted: meditation feeds both paths at once, each at its full pace, no element is barred to it, and its spells strike a quarter harder. The heavens hate it: every tribulation strikes half as many times again.
physique.defying-the-heavens.shattered_m: Meridians that will never hold qi: no cultivation, no heaven methods, no spells. The body can be tempered on past a mortal's Peak instead, eight stages of body refining, the last as strong as a Core Formation cultivator's. Meditation tempers it too. It is never the lot of one already cultivating.
physique.defying-the-heavens.soul_devour: It feeds on souls: every cultivator it slays, players too, gives it a tenth of what the victim's stage takes, on the path it cultivates. Each righteous or neutral one drags its own path toward the devilish, and the righteous think the less of it (-20 regard).
physique.defying-the-heavens.spirit_eye_: Eyes open to what others can't see: from its first day, as if the Ghost Eye were always open, it sees souls and the dead clearly, and the dead and the Method Steles even through walls within 32 blocks, for nothing.
physique.defying-the-heavens.starborn_bo: Born under the stars: the void bears it from Core Formation, a realm before anyone else. A star's heat never burns it, space's thin qi is whole to it, and it flies through space 1.5 times as fast, paying the years of its flight there by as much less.
physique.defying-the-heavens.three_eleme: Roots of three elements only: methods of those three alone, cultivated 1.5 times as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.true_elemen: A single pure root: one element's methods alone, cultivated twice as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.yin_soul_bo: A soul at home in yin: yin corruption never takes hold of it, and the ghost path is cultivated 1.2 times as fast.
A beam of utter cold freezes the being you look at solid, within 48 blocks: 200 water harm, and it is held frozen for 5 s. When anything strikes it, or the cold lets go, it shatters for 60 more.
spell.defying-the-heavens.advanced_flyin: Six swords form in the air round you one after another, then fly one after another at where you look: 9 metal harm each, each passing through one being to strike another.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ancient_bark_s: For 20 s ancient bark grows over you: 20% less harm taken, 40% less of earth's. A wood ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.azure_breathin: For 60 s you can walk and run on water (sneak to sink into it) and breathe under it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.azure_coating_: For 30 s a thin coat of water clings to you: fire cannot burn you and fire spells stop at it (a fire spell of a deeper realm than this still breaks half through). Lava boils it away. A water ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.azure_dragon.d: The Azure Dragon of the east, a dragon of living wood with jade light in its grain, bursts up out of the ground where you look, up to 82 blocks, and flies off into the sky away from you, its long body winding after it. Everything within 18 blocks of where it bursts out takes 480 wood harm and is caught up on its body, carried up and away with it for 2 s and then flung off. The land it bursts from is torn open in fourteen fissures out to 51 blocks.
spell.defying-the-heavens.black_and_whit: The two soul-catchers of the underworld rise out of the mist to either side of the soul you look at, up to 72 blocks, and come for it: the White, who smiles, in white mourning robes and a tall hat, its long red tongue hanging from its mouth, brings its mourning staff down on it, 500 ghostly harm, slowing it; the Black, who scowls, in black, red-eyed, thrusts out its hand and its chain lashes out and binds it, holding it for 3 s at 300 ghostly harm a second; and then both reach in and take their share of its soul, a tenth of its whole health (no more than 1200). The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.black_tortoise: The Black Tortoise of the north, black water under a dome of warding light, rises round you, its serpent a stream coiled about its shell, and keeps by you for 12 s: you and your own within 10 blocks of you take 40% less harm, and fire's not at all (a fire spell of a deeper realm still breaks half through), and its serpent strikes a foe within 20 blocks every second for 200 water harm, throwing it back. A water ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.blade_polish.d: For 30 s every melee blow you strike deals 1.2 times its harm, and the weapon in your hand gives off a faint white glow and wisps of white smoke.
spell.defying-the-heavens.blazing_meteor: Calls a burning meteor down out of the sky onto where you look, up to 48 blocks, its mark glowing on the ground as it falls: 45 fire harm to everything within 6 blocks, burning for 6 s, and a crater 13 blocks round blown out of the ground (or whatever is built there), its floor burnt to magma and blackstone, fires round it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.book_of_life_a: The Book of Life and Death, in which every soul's span is written, opens over your head, its judge's brush red with cinnabar, and finds the names of the foes round you, eight at most within 72 blocks, nearest first: each is marked, shown glowing wherever it is, and for 3 s takes 250 ghostly harm a second. Then the brush strikes their names out: 900 ghostly harm to each, and any left with less than a quarter of its whole health is struck out of life (a great one of the world, the Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Warden, takes 2000 more instead). The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.boulder_cleave: Flings a crescent of sword qi from you the way you look. It flies 15 blocks through the ground as through air, cutting a slot 3 blocks wide and 2 tall through everything it passes (what it cuts is gone), and cleaves every being in its way for 14 metal harm.
Tears a boulder out of the ground ahead of you, leaving a round hole two blocks deep, gathers it in the air and throws it at where you aim, up to 48 blocks: 16 earth harm and a heavy knock back. It tears it from whatever lies ahead, ground or what is built there (not inside a barrier).
A sphere of the sea 16 blocks round fills the place you look at, up to 48 blocks, for 8 s: every foe inside is held in it, drowning, and takes 22 water harm a second. When it lets go, the ground under it is left crushed into a basin 18 blocks round with a lake in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.bridge_of_no_r: The Naihe Bridge, that the dead cross over the River of Forgetting, rises out of the mist along your look, span after span, 118 blocks: everything within 6 blocks of it as it rises takes 300 ghostly harm and forgets every blessing on it (its good effects are gone). Then for 5 s whoever is on or under it is slowed and pays its toll, 50 ghostly harm a second. The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.buried_world.d: A ring of eight standing stones, carved with the spirals and runes of the old world, heaves up out of the land 34 blocks round where you look, up to 154 blocks. For 6 s the land within sinks, 4 blocks deeper every second, every foe within dragged down with it and crushed for 500 earth harm a second. Then the stones topple in on it: 3500 earth harm to every foe within, and the land is left a vast pit.
spell.defying-the-heavens.buzhou_falls.d: The sky tears open 70 blocks over where you look, up to 118 blocks, and out of it falls the broken pillar of Mount Buzhou, that once held up heaven, 59 blocks long: 1600 earth harm to everything within 22 blocks, pinned to the ground for 2 s. The land is smashed into a crater 17 blocks round and 13 deep, and fourteen fissures run out from it to 70 blocks. The pillar stands in it a while, then fades.
spell.defying-the-heavens.cave_formation: Carves a cave fit for one into the slope or ground you look at, within 6 blocks, crumbling it away before your eyes over 3 s: into a slope, an entrance one block wide and two tall with a room three blocks wide, deep and tall behind it; into the ground, three steps down to such a room.
A great tornado of fire rises 3 blocks ahead of you and creeps toward where you aim (up to 40 blocks away) for 10 s. It drags in and lifts whatever comes near, burns all within it for 6 fire harm a second, tears up the ground beneath it (and what is built there) and leaves fire behind.
spell.defying-the-heavens.crimson_temper: For 30 s fire and lava cannot burn you, and lava bears your weight: you can walk and run across it. A fire ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.devouring_seal: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. Seal the being you look at, up to 32 blocks: heaven's seal holds it while a demon's maw devours it, for 8 seconds. It loses 2 hearts a second and is slowed, and half of it comes to you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.dirt_tide.desc: Raises a wave of the earth you stand on and carries you on its crest for 10 s, the way you face, faster than a sprint: forward drives it on, back reins it in, and it climbs a block at a time and rides over water. Sneak to step off.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_dragon_s: A ridge of jagged spikes of the ground's own rock bursts up along the ground from you toward where you face, 24 blocks out, running out as fast as a horse: whatever it passes over takes 20 earth harm and is thrown into the air. The spikes sink back a few seconds later.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_spear.de: Raises clods of earth into the air before you, where they fuse into a podao of dried earth, then flings it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 6 earth harm and a heavy knock back.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_veins_lo: The earth itself heaves up round where you stand: ribs of rock burst out of the land and bend in to meet over you, a dome 26 blocks round, and lock space within it for 6 s: every foe in it, or that comes in, is held where it stands (it can't walk, fly or be thrown out), crushed for 200 earth harm a second, and can't step through space (a Nine Nether Step, a Spatial Tear). The land is left as it was.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_wall_tec: A wall of the ground you stand on, 6 blocks long and 4 tall, rises out of the earth 3 blocks ahead of you, across your way. If you are not on the ground, it forms in mid air, from its middle block outward. It stands for 30 s, then sinks back into the ground.
Raises an earth titan three times a golem's size beside you for 60 s: it flies, keeps by you and fights for you, 400 health and 80 earth harm a blow, its fist striking the ground round its mark too. One at a time.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earthquake.des: The ground shakes 20 blocks round you for 4 s and splits: fourteen fissures up to 7 blocks deep run out from near you as far as 40 blocks, and every foe on the shaking ground takes 14 earth harm a second, is slowed hard and thrown about.
spell.defying-the-heavens.eight_trigrams: Laozi's furnace of the eight trigrams, bronze on three legs with Samadhi fire in it, falls out of the sky onto where you look, up to 136 blocks: 1000 fire harm to everything under it, and a scorched crater 11 blocks round. For 6 s it burns: every foe within 26 blocks is drawn into its belly and held there, burning for 300 fire harm a second, and every 1.5 s jets of Samadhi fire burst out of its eight windows along the land for 51 blocks, striking whatever is in their way for 500 and burning trenches. Then it bursts open: 1500 fire harm to everything within 26 blocks, hurled out, the ground under it melted into a glassy pit 19 blocks round and the land scorched 34 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.emerald_healin: For 10 s you heal 1 health every second, fed or hungry, and glow a faint green.
spell.defying-the-heavens.falling_contin: A land torn up whole, its meadows, forests, snow-capped mountains and a lake on it, the bedrock it was torn from hanging jagged under it, comes down out of the sky from 136 blocks onto where you look, up to 218 blocks away, slowly at first and then ever faster, over 3.6 s, tumbling, rock and earth raining off its rim, its weight pressing down every foe under it. It strikes: 75000 earth harm to everything within 41 blocks, thrown out, the land smashed into a crater 31 blocks round and 12 deep, cracks running 82 blocks out of it; it is driven down into what it smashed and is gone.
spell.defying-the-heavens.falling_mounta: A mountain of rock forms in the sky over where you look, up to 64 blocks, and falls on it: 140 earth harm to everything within 10 blocks, a shockwave, a crater 22 blocks round and 13 deep (its floor broken rubble), and ten fissures splitting the land out to 48 blocks.
spell.defying-the-heavens.fengdu_walls_r: Eight lengths of the walls of Fengdu, the city of the dead, black stone, crenellated, a gate-tower at the middle of each and soul lanterns at their ends, rise out of the land in a ring 37 blocks round where you look, up to 136 blocks away, facing in: for 5 s no foe within gets out past them, and every half second the city's dead fall on every foe within, 800 ghostly harm, slowing them. Then the walls topple in on its heart: 4000 ghostly harm to every foe within. The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.fire_serpent.d: A serpent of fire coils out of your hand and swims through the air at where you aim, bending toward its mark as it goes, up to 48 blocks: 12 fire harm and burning for 4 s.
spell.defying-the-heavens.first_flame_be: The flower of chaos-fire that burned before heaven, its petals of white flame and black by turns, opens where you look, up to 218 blocks away, 34 blocks round, and burns for 5 s: every half second every foe within takes 3000 fire harm. Then its petals slam shut on its heart, drawing every foe within in, and its heart bursts: 45000 fire harm to every foe within, thrown out, the land blown into a crater of glass 27 blocks round and 12 deep.
spell.defying-the-heavens.first_seed_of_: The seed of creation comes down out of the light where you look, up to 218 blocks away, and the dome of life grows over it, great vines arching up out of the land 48 blocks round to meet over it; the land within flourishes. For 6 s it drinks: every half second every foe within is drawn on for 2500 wood harm and slowed, none can leave it, and three tenths of all it draws mends you and your own within. Then the tree of creation bursts up out of the seed through the dome: 45000 wood harm to every foe within, thrown up, the same share of it mending your own.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_armour.d: For 30 s you are clad in armour made of red flame, from its burning crest to its greaves. It takes 10% off all harm you take, and 20% off metal's (metal spells, and blows of iron, gold, diamond or netherite weapons). A fire ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_bolt.des: Shoots a bolt of red flame from your hand at where you aim, up to 40 blocks. It strikes for 5 fire harm and sets its mark burning for 3 s. Water puts it out: a being under a water ward (Azure Coating) takes none of it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_fist.des: For 15 s your fists burn with red and orange flame. Every blow you land sets its mark burning for 5 s and sears it for 1 more fire harm. Against a being under a water ward the flames only hiss out.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flying_sword.d: Forms a sword of metal in the air before you, shard by shard, and shoots it at where you aim, up to 48 blocks: 6 metal harm, and it flies on through its first mark to strike another.
spell.defying-the-heavens.four_swords_ar: Four giant swords plant themselves at the corners of a square 32 blocks across round where you look, up to 48 blocks, each driven deep into the ground in a crater 7 blocks round: for 8 s every foe inside is held in by the walls of light between them and takes 80 metal harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.frozen_field.d: The cold runs out from you to 64 blocks round over two and a half seconds: open water freezes, frost lies on the ground within 32 blocks, and every being it reaches (but your allies and pets) is frozen solid for 3 s. The ice thaws over the next 20 to 40 s, and until it has, every being in the field takes 3 water harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.frozen_moon_in: A crescent moon of ice rises over where you look, up to 154 blocks, its reflection shining up out of a well of still black water under it, 18 blocks round, and the land 24 blocks round freezes. For 4 s every foe in the well is held frozen in it, as the moon is held in the water, and takes 400 water harm a second. Then the moon shatters: 3200 water harm to every foe in the well, and it lets them go.
spell.defying-the-heavens.gate_of_ten_th: A gate of the dead, bone-white mist and ghost fire, opens where you look, up to 82 blocks, for 8 s: every foe within 18 blocks of it is dragged toward it and takes 30 ghostly harm a second. Then it slams shut: 120 ghostly harm to everything within 18 blocks. A quarter of all the harm it does mends you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_core_bur: Your core flares: everything within 5 blocks takes 4 hearts of ghostly harm, is thrown back and set burning with ghost fire.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_fire.des: Wreathe your hands in cold fire: your next 3 blows within 20 seconds set what they strike burning (3 ghost qi each). It burns the dead three times as hard.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_fire_bol: Throw a bolt of ghost fire up to 24 blocks: it strikes the first being in its path and sets it burning.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghostly_wail.d: Your own ghost rises giant at your back and wails: everything within 8 blocks is driven back, slowed and weakened, and the dead are torn at.
spell.defying-the-heavens.glacial_spears: Five spears of ice form over your head and fly in a fan at where you look: 11 water harm each, slowness for 3 s and the cold's frost.
spell.defying-the-heavens.glacier_of_the: The first age's ice heaves up out of the ground 14 blocks ahead of you (on the ground below you, if you cast it in the air) and surges on along your look, 48 blocks across and 102 blocks in 10 s: colossal crystals of ice bursting up out of the land as its front comes, some 14 high, a field of them standing behind it, cold mist rolling off its front. Every foe before its front is shoved along with it (one it overruns is thrown out ahead; a great beast is only ground past), struck for 2500 water harm every half second and chilled, and its way is left frosted, snow over the land and ice over its water, that thaws after a while. At its end its crystals shatter, the shards of its front crashing on ahead: 10000 water harm to everything within 20 blocks before it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.golden_bell_sh: A great golden bell comes down over you for 10 s and takes up to 40 harm for you, tolling with each blow; wood's harm costs it half as much, fire's twice. A metal ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.golden_crow_de: The sky tears open 60 blocks over where you look, up to 118 blocks, and the Golden Crow, the three-legged crow that carries the sun, made of the sun's own fire, bursts out of it and dives: 1600 fire harm to everything within 22 blocks of where it strikes, burning for 10 s. The land there melts into a glassy crater 13 blocks round, and burns round it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.golden_dragon_: A pair of colossal golden scissors, each blade a dragon of gold 64 blocks long, opens 17 blocks over where you look, up to 136 blocks, lying level across your sight, and snaps shut: everything between its blades as they close takes 3500 metal harm and is cut down to the ground. The land is cut 5 blocks wide and 15 deep where the blades meet, and scarred along where they lay open.
spell.defying-the-heavens.gravestone_fal: A colossal stele written with the names of the dead, borne on a stone tortoise, falls out of the sky onto where you look, up to 154 blocks: 3000 earth harm to everything within 10 blocks, pinned for 3 s, the land smashed into a crater 12 blocks round and cracked out to 34. It stands 2 s; then it sinks into the land, dragging every foe within 24 blocks to it and down after it, and buries whatever is within 14 blocks as it goes under: 1500 more, and a pit 10 blocks round and 14 deep where it went.
spell.defying-the-heavens.great_tide.des: A wave 10 blocks tall and 14 wide rolls out 30 blocks the way you face: whatever it overtakes takes 30 water harm, is swept along hard and put out.
The hand of Houtu, mother of the earth, of the land's yellow jade veined with gold, rises open out of the land where you look, up to 218 blocks away, and closes: every foe within 17 blocks takes 15000 earth harm and is caught up in its fist, 15 blocks up (a great beast is only crushed, and held slowed). It holds them a moment, then brings its fist down forward onto the land, carrying them with it: they and everything within 20 blocks of where it lands take 45000 earth harm, the land smashed into a crater 20 blocks round and 9 deep, cracks running 61 blocks out of it.
For 30 s a thin skin of stone covers you, taking 7% off all harm you take (14% off water's). An earth ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_and_dem: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon made one. Everything within 16 blocks is dragged in and takes 25 hearts of harm; a tenth of all of it mends you, and you have Strength II for 10 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_a: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A colossal projection of your own body, 41 blocks tall, rises out of a cloud of gold and crimson behind you for 8 s: its right side heaven's gold, haloed, its hand held up in heaven's sign; its left the demon's crimson, horned in fire, clawed; a seam of fire burning down it where the two meet. Twice it raises a hand and that hand comes down out of the sky where you look, up to 82 blocks: heaven's palm, then the demon's claw. Each strikes everything within 14 blocks for 140 harm and throws it down, slowed; a fifth of all the harm mends you. Heaven's palm crushes a crater 18 blocks round and 8 deep into the land, cracks running out of it to 39 blocks; the demon's claw rakes four gouges 28 blocks long across where it struck.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_b: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A colossal bell, heaven's gold on one side and the demon's crimson bronze on the other, falls out of the sky over where you look, up to 136 blocks, its rim pressing a crater 19 blocks round into the land, and tolls three times, a second apart: each toll strikes everything under it, within 19 blocks, for 500 harm, through armour, and its wave runs out over the land to 38 blocks, striking everything there for 200 and throwing it back, the land cracking under it out to 40 blocks. A fifth of all the harm mends you. Then it rises away.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_c: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A great claw of gold light and crimson demon qi rakes down where you look, up to 32 blocks: everything within 5 blocks takes 15 hearts of harm, is thrown up and weakened for 5 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_e: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. Heaven's sun and the demon's moon come together 58 blocks over where you look, up to 154 blocks, the black moon sliding across the blazing sun until it covers it, its corona flaring out round them; then a beam of darkness edged with crimson and gold pours straight down from the moon's face to the ground, as wide as its harm reaches, and pulses three times, three quarters of a second apart: each strikes everything under it, within 22 blocks, for 1200, then 600, then 600 harm, through armour, holding it where it stands, and the first burns the land into a crater of black glass 19 blocks round and 7 deep, ash and embers welling up about it. A fifth of all the harm mends you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_m: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. Gold light and crimson demon scales wrap you for 10 seconds: arrows and fireballs shot at you are turned back on whoever shot them, and you have Resistance I.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_p: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A palm of gold light, a demon's crimson claw within it, strikes the first being within 16 blocks: 5 hearts of harm, and it is thrown back. A quarter of the harm mends you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_demon_v: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A colossal fist, heaven's gauntlet of gold plates round a demon's crimson claws, forms over your shoulder and punches out to where you look, up to 118 blocks: where it lands, space itself shatters like glass. Everything within 18 blocks takes 520 harm, through armour, and is thrown out; the shattered space hangs there for 5 s, cutting whoever stays in it for 60 harm a second. The land under it is smashed into a crater 28 blocks round and 15 deep, twelve cracks running out of it to 55 blocks.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_piercin: Giant bamboo bursts up out of the ground under as many as 6 foes within 24 blocks of where you look, breaking the ground open 4 blocks round each: 70 wood harm each, and they are thrown high into the air.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_severin: A sword of light as long as a tower forms in your hand and you swing it level across your front: a giant crescent of sword light some 110 blocks across leaves its edge and flies out level from your chest the way you face, 120 blocks, faster than anything can flee it: nothing stops it. It cuts through whatever its blade passes through, 5 blocks thick at its middle and thinner toward its tips: hills and mountains are sliced through (their tops left standing above the cut), trees felled, whatever is built in its way cut in two, and the land at its far end is cut in the crescent's curve. Every being its blade passes through takes 300 metal harm and is hurled ahead of it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_slaying: A sword of sword-light that could slay heaven itself, 94 blocks long, its guard of gold swept up like wings, a halo round its point, rises point first out of the land where you look, up to 218 blocks away: everything within 10 blocks of its blade takes 40000 metal harm, thrown high. It stands a moment, then flares: eight cuts run out from its foot across the land, 82 blocks long, 20000 metal harm to everything within 5 blocks of one (once), the land cut along them 4 blocks wide and 7 deep.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_swallow: A gourd of living jade wood on its vine comes down out of the sky mouth first, to hang 19 blocks over where you look, up to 136 blocks, and its stopper flies off: for 5 s it swallows. The land under it is torn up into it, a bowl 19 blocks round, and every foe within 30 blocks is dragged up toward its mouth: whatever reaches it is swallowed, held inside, weakened and drained for 450 wood harm a second (a great beast is only dragged and drained where it stands). Then it spits them out: 900 wood harm, hurled far.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heavenly_river: A river pours out of the sky along a line from you to where you look, 32 blocks, for 2 s: everyone in its fall takes 60 water harm and is swept along it, and the river scours a channel 6 blocks across into the ground along its line.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heavy_earth_se: Every foe within 24 blocks of you is pressed to the ground for 6 s: it cannot jump or fly (a flier is brought down), is slowed hard, and takes 20 earth harm a second. Under its weight the land 37 blocks round you sinks by up to 3 blocks, cracked and split by fourteen fissures (all but where you stand).
spell.defying-the-heavens.hell_chains.de: A way to hell tears open at your feet and chains of black iron lash out of it to every foe within 12 blocks (with none, the nearest living thing your spells may take), haul them to you and hold them fast for 3 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.hundred_rivers: A hundred streams pour together into a great whirlpool where you look, up to 82 blocks, for 5 s: every foe within 31 blocks is dragged into it and held, taking 90 water harm a second. When it bursts it flings them out, and leaves the ground crushed into a basin 23 blocks round with a lake in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.immortal_bindi: A ring of golden rope, its coils hung with charms and bells, comes to hang 21 blocks over where you look, up to 136 blocks, and its ropes lash out to the foes within 30 blocks of the spot, eight at most, nearest first: each is bound (it can't walk, fly or strike back), hauled up to hang under the ring and held there for 5 s, constricted for 450 metal harm a second. Then the ropes cinch, 900 more, and let go; what they held lands unharmed by the fall. A great beast is bound where it stands.
spell.defying-the-heavens.karmic_fire.de: Sets karmic fire on the being you look at, within 32 blocks, for 8 s, burning away its sins: each second it takes 1 harm if it is guiltless, up to 11 for a devil (by its alignment), 6 for a monster, a little for a beast or a villager. A sinner's alignment burns 2 a second toward neutral.
spell.defying-the-heavens.kings_decree.d: A Ghost King's word: every foe within 16 blocks is weakened, slowed and shown glowing for 8 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.kun_rises_from: Kun Rises from the Northern Abyss

The land where you look, up to 118 blocks, opens onto the northern abyss, and the Kun, the fish of the abyss that becomes the Peng, made of its black water and more than 60 blocks long, breaches out of it and leaps across your sight: everything within 22 blocks takes 1500 water harm and is thrown high. As it dives back in, 500 more, and the land there is crushed into a basin 18 blocks round with a lake in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.life_force_dra: For 6 s you draw on the being you look at or a herb growing there (a ginseng), within 12 blocks, or on a single Cultivation Fruit or herb you hold (a fruit on its tree can't be drawn on). What you draw out of a being is your choice (its switch in the Spells tab): its health, 1.5 a second, healing you; its qi, 40 a second out of another player's pool (six tenths of it yours), or out of a being that keeps none its life burnt into your qi; or its years, 10 of another player's lifespan a second, half of them yours. A herb or fruit loses 60 years a second, and you heal 1 a second. A stream of light runs from it to you, green for health, blue for qi, gold for years. It breaks if you stray 16 blocks apart. Herbs in a sect's or a Ghost King's treasury can't be touched while its seal holds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.life_force_gai: For 6 s you pour yourself into the being you look at, or into an aging herb or fruit growing within 12 blocks, or a single one you hold. What you give a being is your choice (its switch in the Spells tab): your health, healing it 2 a second for 1 of yours (never below 4); your qi, 40 a second into another player's pool (a being that keeps none is healed by it); or your years, 10 of your lifespan a second given another player (never your last 10). A herb or fruit grows on your own years: it gains 120 years a second for 10 years of your lifespan a second (never your last 10). Herbs in a sealed treasury can't be touched.
spell.defying-the-heavens.lotus_of_rebir: A great lotus opens at your feet for 10 s: you and every friendly being within 10 blocks are cleansed of harmful effects and fire at once, and heal 3 health a second while it blooms.
spell.defying-the-heavens.marrow_ward.de: Your bones hold like iron for 10 seconds: Resistance II and 4 hearts of absorption.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mineral_purifi: Every ore within the reach of your consciousness (your Consciousness Domain's radius) gives up its ore: it streams to you as light and is yours, as mined and unsmelted, the rock it lay in left behind. At most 256 ores, the nearest first. Ores inside a raised barrier (protective or concealment) are beyond its reach.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mirror_of_retr: The karma mirror of Yama's court, that shows every soul its sins, rises over you, behind your head, and turns with your look for 3 s: its light pours out over you along your look, 64 blocks, and every being in it is shown its sins: it takes 140 ghostly harm a second, is weakened and slowed, and is shown glowing wherever it hides for 8 s. Then the mirror flashes: 500 ghostly harm to everything in its light. The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mist_veil.desc: A thick mist rises 10 blocks round you for 15 s, moving with you: foes in it lose sight of you and your allies (unless within 3 blocks of them), and missiles flying into it slow to half their speed.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mountain_cleav: Flings a crescent of sword qi as tall as a tower the way you look. It flies 140 blocks, cutting a slot 6 blocks wide and 23 tall through hills and mountains alike (what it cuts is gone), and cleaves every being in its way for 150 metal harm.
A mountain of stone bursts up over where you look, up to 48 blocks, 7 blocks round and 9 tall, tearing the land open round its foot in fourteen fissures out to 40 blocks: everything inside is entombed, held fast for 5 s and crushed for 60 earth harm a second. The mountain crumbles away after 20 s; its stone gives nothing.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mountain_stanc: For 15 s you stand like a mountain, clad in slabs of stone: 25% less harm taken (50% less of water's), and nothing can knock you back, but you walk a fifth slower. An earth ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.myriad_swords_: Ten thousand swords gather in a turning vortex high over where you look, up to 82 blocks, and fuse into one colossal sword 53 blocks long that falls: 600 metal harm to everything within 15 blocks, a cross of slots 60 blocks out each way and a pit 19 deep where it is driven in. It stands there a while, then fades.
spell.defying-the-heavens.myriad_vine_bi: Vines burst up and seize as many as 12 foes within 40 blocks of where you look, up to 64 blocks: each is held fast for 5 s and takes 22 wood harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.myriad_woods_r: Myriad Woods Return to the Dao

A spirit tree of jade light grows where you stand and holds the land 41 blocks round for 15 s: every foe in it is rooted and drained of 40 health a second, all of it shared out as healing to you and your own within the woods.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mysterious_bri: Thorny bristles burst up out of the ground round the being you look at, within 20 blocks, and close over it: it is held where it stands for 4 s, torn for 1.5 wood harm a second. Three blows on the cage break it, from outside or in; but each one the prisoner strikes from inside tears it for 2 more.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_cauldrons: The nine bronze cauldrons Yu the Great cast for the nine provinces fall out of the sky one after another: the first on where you look, up to 136 blocks, the rest in a ring 30 blocks round it. Each strikes everything within 11 blocks of where it lands for 1500 earth harm and smashes a crater 9 blocks round (the first 13). Once all nine stand, for 6 s they suppress the land within the ring: every foe inside is pressed down (it can't fly or leap, slowed to a crawl, weakened) and takes 250 earth harm a second, and the land within sinks 6 blocks. Then they rise away.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_nether_st: Step through the dark to where you look, up to 24 blocks, short of any wall. Falls do you no harm for a moment after.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_rebirths_: A colossal sword wreathed in white flame forms over where you look, up to 154 blocks away, its hilt over the spot and its 55-block blade reaching out, and sweeps round it eight times, 210 degrees a sweep, turning the other way each time and reborn in its white flame between them, its point skimming the land, rising off it or falling onto it: everything within 53 blocks it passes over takes 600 metal harm, once a sweep. Reborn a ninth time high over the spot, point-down, it plunges into it: everything within 24 blocks takes 2000 metal harm, the land glassed into a crater 14 blocks round and 7 deep, cracks running 38 blocks out of it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_suns_desc: Nine suns fall out of the sky, one after another, onto where you look and round it, up to 64 blocks: each bursts for 150 fire harm 7 blocks round, burning for 6 s, and blows a scorched crater 9 blocks round out of the ground: together they leave the land a burning field of craters 19 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ocean_sealing_: A vase of white jade painted with waves, that holds an ocean, comes over where you look, up to 136 blocks, its mouth tipped down 30 blocks over the land, and drinks for 5 s: every drop of water within 42 blocks is drawn up out of the land into it, lakes and rivers left dry, and every foe within it is dragged up into its streams; whatever reaches its mouth is held there and crushed for 400 water harm a second. Then it seals itself and comes down mouth first: 1500 water harm to everything within 21 blocks, thrown out, and the ocean it held poured back into a crater 17 blocks round, a lake in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.one_flame_burn: A seed of white flame flies from your hand to where you look, up to 82 blocks, and blooms into a pillar of fire 10 blocks round that rises to the clouds, 118 blocks, for 6 s: everything in it takes 120 fire harm a second and burns (a water ward of a lower realm only halves it), and the ground under it melts into a glassy pit 10 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.phoenix_descen: A phoenix of fire takes wing from you and flies at where you aim, bending toward its mark, up to 64 blocks, and bursts there: 90 fire harm to everything within 5 blocks, burning for 6 s, and a scorched crater 7 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.phoenix_nirvan: For 60 s the phoenix's fire waits in you: if you would die, you rise again instead at full health, harmful effects burnt away, in a burst of flame that strikes everyone but your allies within 10 blocks for 200 fire harm. Once.
spell.defying-the-heavens.piercing_sword: A beam of sword light pierces everything along your look for 64 blocks, walls and hills too: it bores a tunnel 5 blocks across through whatever stands in its way, and every being along it takes 55 metal harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.primal_axe_spl: Pangu's axe, that split heaven from earth, stands behind you, 85 blocks tall, and is raised back over you, then chops down forward along your look: everything within 10 blocks of its line, out to 89 blocks, takes 75000 metal harm, thrown aside, and the land is split into a chasm along it, 9 blocks wide and 27 deep (from 10 blocks ahead of you), cracks running 34 blocks out where its head lands.
spell.defying-the-heavens.primal_wind_of: A cyclone of the primal wind, green and gold, the leaves and seeds of creation whirled up in it, forms where you look, up to 218 blocks away, and wanders on along your look for 8 s, 56 blocks: every foe within 41 blocks is drawn in to it, and those within 17 whirled up round it as high as 24 and struck for 3000 wood harm every half second (a great beast only drawn, slowly). The land it passes over flourishes. At its end it flings them out, 12000 wood harm to each; a twentieth of all its harm mends you and your own near it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.primordial_cha: A spell of both paths, heaven and demon. A sphere of the chaos before heaven and earth were parted, heaven's gold and the demon's crimson swirled together, swells out of a point 24 blocks over where you look, up to 218 blocks away, and churns for 5 s: everything within 54 blocks is drawn in toward it, and every half second everything within 27 blocks of its heart takes 1000 harm, through armour. Then it bursts: 15000 harm to everything within 34 blocks, through armour, thrown out, the land under it burnt into a crater of glass 24 blocks round and 10 deep. A fifth of all the harm mends you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.procession_of_: A column of the dead, ghost fire and mist, pours out along your look for 61 blocks, 8 wide: every being it passes through takes 90 ghostly harm and is slowed and weakened for 5 s. The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.pyre_of_the_he: A ring of cribs of great logs, stacked crosswise and burning, walls of fire between them, rises 29 blocks round where you look, up to 154 blocks, and burns for 8 s: no foe inside gets out through its walls of fire (it is thrown back in, burning), and every foe within takes 150 fire harm a second, 100 more each second after as the pyre roars higher. Then it collapses in on its heart: 2500 fire harm to every foe within, and the land is blown into a vast scorched crater 29 blocks round and 12 deep, burning 43 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.qilin_tramples: A qilin of rock, molten gold in its cracks, rears beside you and stamps, then gallops out along your look for 128 blocks, over the land: every stride cracks a crater in it, and everything it tramples takes 480 earth harm and is thrown high.
spell.defying-the-heavens.rain_call.desc: Calls a rain cloud of your own over where you stand, 8 blocks round, for 20 s. Everyone under it but you is slowed by a tenth, and the rain puts out fires and whatever burns.
spell.defying-the-heavens.remote_yang_bo: Leaves a ball of yang fire on the surface you look at, within 16 blocks. Only you, and those with Qi Sense open, can see it. While it waits it draws 1 qi a second from you. Cast the spell again within 48 blocks to set it off: 14 fire harm to everything within 4 blocks, burning for 4 s, and a blast that throws them back. Setting it off costs nothing; the spell then rests for 15 s. It gutters out if your qi runs dry or you go far from it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.return_to_the_: The Cultivation Fruit you hold fly from your hand on streams of green light up into the tree you look at, within 24 blocks, and hang there again under its leaves, as many as it has room for (six at most): each as old as it was when it was picked. On the bough a fruit ripens on with the years again, as a fruit picked never does. Nothing is hung in a sealed treasury, nor where you may not build.
spell.defying-the-heavens.rift_to_the_ni: The ground where you look, up to 118 blocks, tears open onto the Nine Nethers, nine rings of ghost fire turning down into it, for 6 s: every foe within 22 blocks is dragged toward it and down, and takes 100 ghostly harm a second. Then it seals: 300 ghostly harm to everything within 8 blocks of it, and Weakness II for 8 s. The dead take half as much again. The land is left as it was.
spell.defying-the-heavens.samadhi_true_f: The three true fires of Samadhi, the heart's crimson, the spirit's gold and the essence's white, erupt where you look, up to 218 blocks away, in three pillars braided about one another, scorching the land, and burn for 8 s: every foe within 34 blocks is drawn in to them, and every half second every foe within 17 takes 2500 fire harm, true fire that burns the fire-proof too. Then the three meet in one white flare: 20000 fire harm to every foe within 27 blocks, thrown out, the land burnt into a scorched crater 17 blocks round and 9 deep.
The six paths turn: your health is made whole, your harmful effects are gone, and half your yin corruption with them.
The ground round where you look, up to 48 blocks, becomes a sea of flame for 10 s: the land itself burns 31 blocks round (grass scorched, patches turned to magma and netherrack, fires on whatever stands there, trees catching), and every foe standing within 20 blocks of its heart takes 20 fire harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.seal_of_ten_th: An imperial seal of carved stone as great as a hill falls out of the sky onto where you look, up to 82 blocks: 550 earth harm to everything within 18 blocks, held pressed to the ground for 3 s, and the land 41 blocks across pressed down 4 blocks, split by twelve fissures out to 40. The seal stands there a while, then fades.
spell.defying-the-heavens.seed_of_wither: A seed half withered and half alive is shot from your hands along your look, falling a little as it flies, up to some 150 blocks. Striking a being, it seals it in a pod of roots and blossom, bound where it stands, 600 wood harm, and for 5 s drinks 500 of its health a second, half of it mending you; striking the ground, it plants itself, its living roots reaching up out of the land to every foe within 14 blocks, binding them and drinking 300 a second out of each. Then the flower of rebirth blooms out of it: 2500 wood harm to what it held, 1200 to every other foe within 12 blocks, and the land 29 blocks round it flourishes. Shot into the open sky, it withers in the air.
spell.defying-the-heavens.seven_treasure: A branch of the bodhi tree, hung with the seven treasures, is planted where you look, up to 85 blocks away, and bursts up out of the land into a towering bodhi tree 32 blocks tall. Its roots burst up round it and seize every foe within 30 blocks, holding them where they stand. Then its seven treasures fall from its boughs one after another, each onto one of those it holds: each bursts in its own light, 650 wood harm to everything within 5 blocks of it. Then the tree sheds its leaves in a storm and sinks back into the land.
spell.defying-the-heavens.six_paths_anni: Six pillars of cold fire rise round you: everything within 12 blocks takes 20 hearts of ghostly harm and is hurled away.
spell.defying-the-heavens.solar_field.de: A small sun burns 8 blocks above you for 10 s. Everyone else within 40 blocks of you is set burning, every second, as if standing in fire (a water ward or a fire-proof body excepted).
spell.defying-the-heavens.soul_dash.desc: Rush forward on the yin wind, about eight blocks, your own ghost left along the way. Falls do you no harm for a moment after.
spell.defying-the-heavens.soul_locking_p: A pagoda of seven tiers, black iron and bone forged in the lowest hell, its eaves hung with soul lanterns, falls out of the sky onto where you look, up to 136 blocks: 300 ghostly harm to everything under it. Every foe within 15 blocks of it is locked in it for 6 s: it can't leave (it is brought back to its walls) and takes 120 ghostly harm a second, ghost fire pouring from the eaves. Then it seals: 500 ghostly harm to all locked in it, and Weakness II for 10 s. The dead take half as much again. The land is left as it was.
spell.defying-the-heavens.soul_rend.desc: A beam of the Nine Nethers' dark, 32 blocks: every being in its line takes 8 hearts of ghostly harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.spring_of_myri: A green rain of life falls 32 blocks round you for 10 s: you and every friendly being in it heal 40 health at once, then 4 a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.spring_thunder: Spring Thunder of the Azure Emperor

Thunder is wood's, the east's and the spring's. A storm cloud of jade gathers 40 blocks over where you look, up to 118 blocks, the thunder trigram burning beneath it, and calls the Azure Emperor's spring thunder down: six volleys, a second apart, and in each every foe under it, within 26 blocks, is struck by a bolt of jade lightning for 220 wood harm and rooted where it stands. Its other bolts pock the land with little craters.
spell.defying-the-heavens.steel_hurrican: You dash the way you look with your weapon thrust before you, spinning like a trident's riptide, for 1.6 s: every being you meet takes your weapon's blow and 3 metal harm more. No fall harm from it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.summon_golem.d: Raises an earth golem out of the ground beside you for 90 s. It flies (at three fifths of a cultivator's flight), keeps by you and fights for you: whatever strikes you or you strike, or a monster that comes for you. 80 health, 18 earth harm a blow. Two at most: a third sends the oldest back to the earth.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sun_through_th: Space tears open in a slash across the sky over where you look, up to 118 blocks, and a sun is dragged out of it, the rift closing behind it. It hangs 29 blocks over the land for 5 s: everything within 40 blocks beneath it takes 100 fire harm a second and burns, and the land scorches. Then it collapses and bursts: 1200 fire harm to everything within 26 blocks, thrown out, and the ground under it melted into a glassy crater 17 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sword_domain.d: Thirty-six swords circle you 10 blocks round for 12 s: every foe within takes 20 metal harm every half second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sword_rain.des: Twelve swords form in a ring high over where you look, up to 32 blocks, and plunge down round it: 6 metal harm each.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sword_tomb_awa: The grave of fallen swordsmen, a ring of 24 of their swords buried point-down in the earth, bursts up out of the land 12 blocks round where you look, up to 154 blocks away: everything within the ring takes 1000 metal harm, thrown up. The swords tear free, rise over the ring with their points turned in on its heart, and plunge into it one after another: each strikes everything within 6 blocks of where it lands for 160 metal harm (3840 from all 24), and the last leaves a crater 7 blocks round and 5 deep.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ten_direction_: Space tears open in ten places round where you look, up to 118 blocks: out of eight rifts in a ring, great swords plunge into the land 13 blocks round, walls of sword light between them, and for 6 s every foe inside is held in and takes 150 metal harm a second. Then the last two swords, from a rift above and a rift in the ground below, meet in its heart: 1000 metal harm to every foe inside, and a pit where they met.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ten_thousand_s: A pit of the dark opens where you look, up to 136 blocks away, and a whirlwind of ghost fire winds up out of it, the souls of the dead pouring up it by the hundred, wailing faces as they rise out of the dark that burn away into wisps of cold blue fire as they climb. For 5 s every foe within 34 blocks is drawn in to it, and those within 14 carried up round it as high as 20 (a great beast only drawn, slowly), the souls tearing at them, 1000 ghostly harm every half second. Then it is dragged back down into the dark, dragging them down with it: 5000 ghostly harm to each. The dead take half as much again.
spell.defying-the-heavens.the_frozen_moo: A moon of ice, cratered and cracked with cold light, its frost streaming up behind it, falls out of the sky from 96 blocks onto where you look, up to 154 blocks: 6500 water harm to everything within 24 blocks, thrown out. The land is smashed into a crater of ice 29 blocks round and 14 deep and frozen round it out to 38, and every foe within that is chilled, slowed for 8 s.
spell.defying-the-heavens.the_primordial: The waters before heaven and earth well up where you look, up to 218 blocks away, in a ring of towering waves 39 blocks round, curling in, the sea within them wheeling in a whirlpool under a storm that rains down over all of it, lightning striking into the sea. For 5 s every foe within is dragged round in it (a great beast only slowed), none can leave, and every half second it drowns them for 3000 water harm. Then its waves crash in over its heart: 45000 water harm to every foe within, the land under it left a lake 27 blocks round and 9 deep.
spell.defying-the-heavens.thorn_spear_fo: Spears of thorny wood burst out of the ground 6 blocks round where you look, up to 32 blocks: every foe there takes 35 wood harm and is held where it stands for 2 s.
spell.defying-the-heavens.thousand_leaf_: Sixteen razor leaves stream from your palm over a second, each bending a little toward a foe: 2.5 wood harm each, every one its own cut. Against a fire ward they burn to ash.
spell.defying-the-heavens.tidal_lance.de: A jet of water bursts from your hands for 2 s, as far as 24 blocks: the first being in it takes 6 water harm every half second and is driven back along it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.torrential_spr: Gathers a great ball of water out of the air above and ahead of you over 1.5 s, then drops it on where you look, up to 32 blocks: 8 water harm to everything within 4 blocks, a heavy wash that throws them back, and a small lake pressed into the ground where it falls.
spell.defying-the-heavens.twenty_four_se: The twenty-four pearls that fix the sea unwind round you, circling 7 blocks out, and fly off one after another at the foes within 64 blocks, nearest first, round and round them (at where you look, with none): each bursts with the weight of the sea, 140 water harm to everything within 4 blocks, and leaves a little crater.
The ember the phoenix leaves when it burns, wrapped in feathers of flame, flies from your hands to where you look, up to 154 blocks, and hangs 5 blocks over the land there. It bursts three times, a second and a quarter apart, sinking low after each and blazing up again, each burst greater than the last: everything within 10, then 13, then 17 blocks takes 1100, then 1500, then 2100 fire harm, burning for 6 s, and is thrown out, and the land is blown into a scorched crater 6, then 8, then 11 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.vajra_body.des: For 12 s your skin turns to gold: 35% less harm taken (70% less of wood's), nothing can knock you back, and whoever strikes you in melee takes 4 metal harm. A metal ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.verdant_growth: A tree grows up out of the ground under your feet in two seconds, lifting you 14 blocks into the air on its trunk, and spreads a blossoming crown round you at the top. It stands for 60 s, then withers away; its wood and leaves give nothing when broken. Cast it standing on the ground.
spell.defying-the-heavens.vermilion_bird: The Vermilion Bird of the south, a bird of living flame, its wings 53 blocks across, stoops out of the sky behind you and sweeps low along your look for 154 blocks, over the hills in its way: everything in its 20-block path takes 450 fire harm and burns for 8 s, and the land beneath it is scorched into a burning trench.
spell.defying-the-heavens.void_severing_: A sword of light thrusts out of your hands along your look, 147 blocks, through whatever stands in its way, and cleaves the land under it into a chasm in the rift's own shape: pointed at both ends, some 13 blocks across and 17 deep at its middle, its sides ragged. Every being on its line or down in the chasm takes 1500 metal harm and is hurled on along it. It cuts space itself: behind it the line stays torn open for 3 s, and every second whoever is in the cut, on the line or down in the chasm, takes 400 metal harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.void_withering: Space tears open in a slash across the sky 33 blocks over where you look, up to 118 blocks, and the roots of the tree that grows in the void spill down out of it. For 8 s they reach out and drink: a root lashes down to each foe within 37 blocks, eight at most, coils round it and hauls it up into the air (a great beast is only held), and every foe within reach is drained of 200 health a second, weakened and slowed, all of it shared out as healing to you and your own within reach. The land beneath them withers. Then they let go and draw back into the rift.
spell.defying-the-heavens.water_arrow.de: Forms an arrow of swirling water in the air and shoots it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 5 water harm, and whatever burns on its mark is put out. Strong against fire wards.
spell.defying-the-heavens.water_prison.d: Encases the being you look at, within 16 blocks, in a sphere of water for 4 s. The air is drawn out of it at once: it drowns from the first second (no held breath), takes 2 water harm a second besides, and is held where it is. 30 harm struck on the sphere bursts it, the prisoner's own blows from inside too.
spell.defying-the-heavens.weak_water_fro: Space tears open 40 blocks over where you look, up to 118 blocks, and the Weak Water, that bears nothing up, not even a feather, pours out of it for 6 s: everything within 26 blocks of where it falls sinks (nothing flies in it, the dead neither), is slowed, has its fires put out, and takes 160 water harm a second. The land under it sinks into a basin 18 blocks round, a lake left in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.white_tiger_po: The White Tiger of the west, made of steel and sword light, leaps from you onto where you look, up to 82 blocks: 500 metal harm to everything within 10 blocks where it lands. Then its claws rake out ahead of it: four gouges 102 blocks long are cut through the land, and everything in them takes 300 metal harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.wind_fire_whee: Two great wheels of fire and whirling wind flare up before you and roll out along your look for 128 blocks, over the land, weaving 13 blocks out to either side and crossing midway: everything a wheel runs over, within 6 blocks of it, takes 1800 fire harm and burns for 10 s, and each burns a trench into the land behind it. Where they meet again at the end they burst: 1200 fire harm to everything within 17 blocks, thrown out, and a scorched crater 11 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.withering_and_: The wheel of the seasons, spring's green and autumn's dry earth turning about a tree half in blossom and half bare, grows out of the land where you look, up to 154 blocks, 34 blocks round, and turns for 8 s: every foe on it is drained of 450 health a second and slowed, and three tenths of all it drains is shared out mending you and your own on it; the land to your left flourishes, to your right withers. Then its last turn: 3000 wood harm to every foe on it, a fifth of it mending you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.wood_bullet.de: Grows a sharp wooden stake in the air before you, then shoots it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 5 wood harm and a small knock back. Against a fire ward (Crimson Tempering, Flame Armour) the stake burns to ash.
spell.defying-the-heavens.world_tree.des: The World Tree grows out of the ground where you look (or before you), its roots heaving the land open in twelve fissures out to 40 blocks, and towers over all for 12 s. Its vines reach from its boughs for every being but you within 32 blocks of its trunk (your pets spared), lift them into its branches and hold them there, drinking 10 of their health a second into you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.xirang_self_gr: A clod of Xirang, the soil that grows of itself, that Gun stole from heaven to dam the flood, flies from your hands to where you look, up to 136 blocks, and swells: the land there heaves up into a mound 17 blocks round and 13 high, stone at its heart and earth and grass over it, burying whatever stands there. Every foe in it is held fast, buried, for 4 s and crushed for 500 earth harm a second; then the mound settles on them, 600 more. The mound stays.
spell.defying-the-heavens.yama_verdict.d: Judge the being you look at, up to 32 blocks: 10 hearts of ghostly harm, twice that if it is below half its health.
spell.defying-the-heavens.yellow_springs: A surge of the Yellow Springs' water rushes 7 blocks ahead: all it reaches is driven back and slowed, and the dead take 3 hearts.
technique.defying-the-heavens.clone.desc: Split a clone off your body and walk in it as yourself: your realm, abilities and spells, half your strength.
